# Dental VeneersUpgrade Your Smile


We understand how much a beautiful smile can boost your confidence. Dental veneers can make a big difference by covering imperfections and enhancing your teeth. Our custom-made veneers are designed to match your unique smile, giving you natural and stunning results. Whether you're dealing with discoloration, gaps, or chips, our experienced dentists ensure the process is comfortable and the results are long-lasting.

What Are Dental Veneers?


## Beautiful and Natural-Looking Smile with Dental Veneers


Dental veneers are thin porcelain shells bonded to the front of your teeth, offering a natural-looking solution to enhance your smile. These cosmetic restorations can completely transform your appearance and boost your confidence. Our experienced dentists provide fast and lasting smile makeovers, addressing a variety of imperfections with veneers.

Discolored or Stained/Yellow Teeth: Brighten your smile by covering stains or discoloration.

Gaps and Chipped Teeth: Achieve a smooth, even look by closing gaps and repairing chips.

Mildly Crooked or Misshapen Teeth: Create a more uniform appearance by aligning and reshaping teeth.

Transformative Benefits of Dental Veneers


## Benefits of Dental Veneers


Dental veneers offer a range of benefits that can enhance both the appearance and functionality of your teeth. By improving the aesthetics of your teeth, veneers can significantly boost your confidence and overall self-esteem.


### Natural Appearance


Veneers are designed to look just like natural teeth, providing a seamless blend with your existing smile.


### Durability


With proper care, porcelain veneers can last over a decade, offering a long-term solution to various dental imperfections.


### Stain Resistance


Unlike natural teeth, porcelain veneers are highly resistant to stains from coffee, tea, and other common culprits, helping you maintain a bright smile.


### Versatility


Veneers can address a wide range of cosmetic issues, including discoloration, gaps, chips, and misaligned teeth, giving you a uniform and attractive smile.

No-Prep/ No-Shave Veneers


## True No-Prep Veneers — Designed Without Shaving


Many patients want a brighter, more balanced smile but hesitate at traditional veneers that require drilling enamel for space. Dr. Krystal Pham focuses on true no-prep / no-shave porcelain veneers for qualified smiles: an additive approach that places custom porcelain without intentional enamel reduction to create room.

With UCSF training, AACD involvement, and 20+ years in cosmetic and family care, Dr. Pham prioritizes candidacy honesty over a one-size-fits-all pitch. You’ll get a careful smile evaluation — and clear guidance when no-prep is (or isn’t) the right path — so the result stays natural-looking and conservative.

Superior Materials: We use E-max veneers, which are thinner, stronger, and more durable than traditional veneers. They resist chips, fractures, and stains, ensuring your smile stays beautiful longer.

Expert Solutions for Dark Teeth: For very dark teeth, we use Zirconia covered in clear porcelain to effectively mask discoloration while maintaining a natural look.

Expertise: Our lead dentist, Dr. Pham is an expert in cosmetic dentistry. She is a member of the American Academy of Cosmetic Dentistry and taught at UCSF School of Dentistry which is widely regarded as a top dental school.

The Veneer Journey


## Getting Dental Veneers is Straighforward: The Process at Oceanic Dental



###### Free Consultation


Start with a free consultation to meet with our doctors, have photos taken, and discuss your smile goals. We’ll evaluate your smile, review treatment options, and answer all your questions to ensure you feel confident.


###### Personalized Planning


We use X-rays and 3D oral scans to understand your preferences. Using specialized templates and custom shades from our cosmetic lab, we plan your veneers. If needed, we’ll create a wax-up model of your new smile for your review.


###### Preparation & Preview


We gently remove a small amount of enamel and apply temporary veneers while your permanent ones are crafted. This step ensures comfort and lets you preview your new smile.


###### Placement


Your veneers are custom-crafted in our lab to match the exact shape and shade of your teeth. We bond the veneers to your teeth and make any necessary adjustments for a perfect fit and comfortable bite to ensure you’re delighted with your new smile.


## FAQs


Find answers to commonly asked questions about dental veneers.

How long do veneers last?

Porcelain veneers typically last 10 to 15 years, or longer with proper care. Maintaining good oral hygiene and regular dental checkups can help extend their lifespan.

Are veneers painful to get?

The process is generally painless. We use local anesthesia to ensure you’re comfortable while preparing your teeth for veneers. Some patients may experience mild sensitivity after the procedure, but this usually fades quickly.

How much do veneers cost?

The cost of porcelain veneers varies based on the number of veneers needed and the complexity of the case. On average, veneers range from $900 to $2,500 per tooth. We’ll provide a detailed cost estimate during your consultation, and flexible payment options are available.

Do veneers stain or discolor?

Porcelain veneers are highly resistant to staining and discoloration. However, it's still a good idea to maintain proper oral hygiene and avoid excessive consumption of stain-causing foods and drinks to keep them looking their best.

Do veneers weaken my original teeth?

Veneers are designed to enhance and protect the visible surface of your teeth, but traditional veneers typically require some enamel removal. Dr. Pham takes a more conservative approach, specializing in no-prep/no-shave veneers that preserve your natural enamel whenever possible. Her philosophy is to achieve a beautiful, lasting smile with little to no alteration to your healthy natural teeth.

# Fixing Smiles, One Crown at a Time


Porcelain crowns are a fantastic solution to restore damaged teeth, offering both durability and a natural look. Our custom-made crowns are designed to blend seamlessly with your existing teeth, ensuring a perfect fit and a stunning result. Let our experienced dentists help you achieve the smile you deserve with our concierge-level dental care.

What’s a Crown Anyway?


## Why Crowns Are Awesome


Porcelain crowns are tooth-shaped caps that are placed over damaged or decayed teeth to restore their shape, size, strength, and appearance. They are made from high-quality porcelain, which mimics the natural translucency of teeth, making them an ideal choice for a natural-looking restoration. Whether you need to protect a weakened tooth, cover a discolored tooth, or support a tooth with a large filling, porcelain crowns provide a versatile and effective solution.

Strengthening Teeth: To cover and protect teeth that have been severely weakened by large cavities or extensive decay.

Post-Root Canal and Implants: To protect teeth after root canals and to attach to dental implants for replacing missing teeth.

Aesthetic and Functional Improvements: Enhance the color, shape, and alignment of teeth, and correct bite issues.

Restore Your Smile with Ease


## Getting a Porcelain Crown is a Straightforward and Stress-Free Experience


At Oceanic Dental, getting a porcelain crown is a simple and stress-free experience. Our dental experts ensure that every step is tailored to your specific needs, providing you with a high-quality crown that's durable and natural-looking, restoring your smile to its best.


### Free Consultation & Personalized Planning


Start with a complimentary consultation where you'll meet our friendly doctors, have photos taken, and discuss your dental goals. We’ll evaluate your teeth, explore treatment options, and answer all your questions. With detailed X-rays, 3D oral scans, and precise planning, we ensure your crown will be a perfect fit.


### Preparation and Custom Crafting


We carefully prepare your tooth by removing any decay and shaping it for the crown. An impression is then taken to create your custom crown. You'll receive a temporary crown while the permanent one is crafted.


### Placement and Final Adjustments


Once your permanent crown is ready, we will schedule an appointment for its placement. Our dentists will ensure a precise fit, making any necessary adjustments to ensure your comfort and bite alignment. This process ensures you receive a high-quality porcelain crown with minimal hassle, restoring your smile to its best.

Why Us


## Dental Crown Artistry: Where Precision Meets Personalization


At Oceanic Dental, we believe a dental crown should do more than restore a tooth—it should blend seamlessly into your smile, feel completely natural, and stand the test of time. That’s why our highly skilled doctors and expert technicians approach every crown with meticulous care and craftsmanship.

Each crown is custom-designed to match the exact shade, shape, and translucency of your natural teeth, ensuring a flawless, lifelike result.

With ultra-precise margins and high-quality materials, we create crowns that not only look beautiful but also function effortlessly.

Every detail, from the way light reflects off the surface to the perfect fit against your gumline, is carefully considered.

At Oceanic Dental, we don’t just make crowns—we create seamless extensions of your natural teeth, restoring confidence and comfort with every smile.


## FAQs


Find answers to commonly asked questions about dental crowns.

How long do porcelain crowns last?

Porcelain crowns typically last between 10 to 15 years with proper care. Regular dental checkups and good oral hygiene can help extend their lifespan.

Does getting a crown hurt?

The process is usually pain-free as we use local anesthesia to numb the area. You might experience mild discomfort after the procedure, but it typically subsides within a few days.

How much does a crown cost?

The cost of a high-quality porcelain crown typically ranges from $1,200 to $2,500 per tooth, depending on the complexity of the case and the materials used. Each case is unique, and we’ll provide you with a personalized estimate during your consultation. Flexible payment options are available to help manage the cost.

What is the difference between a crown and a veneer?

A crown covers the entire tooth and is often used for structural repairs, while a veneer is a thin layer that only covers the front surface of the tooth to improve appearance.

Can crowns be whitened?

No, crowns are made from materials that do not respond to traditional whitening treatments. If you’re considering whitening, it's best to do so before getting a crown so the crown can be matched to your desired shade.

# Comprehensive Dental Services for Every Smile


From routine care to advanced treatments, explore the full spectrum of concierge dental services we offer, all under one roof, to keep your smile shining bright.


## General Dentistry



### Welcome to Your First Visit & New Patient Exam


Your first dental visit should not be stressful. Our welcoming staff will assist you as we take X-rays, perform a gentle examination, and create a personalized treatment plan.


### Cleanings & Gum Disease Treatment


We provide regular professional cleaning, and our in-house board-certified periodontist provides gum treatment, including gum surgery, extraction, bone graft, and implants.


### Tooth-Colored Fillings for a Natural Look


At Oceanic Dental, we offer durable composite tooth-colored fillings that closely match your teeth's natural color. Our fillings blend seamlessly with your smile, restoring your teeth to their natural beauty.


## Cosmetic Dentistry



### Cosmetic Dentistry & Teeth Whitening


Enhance your smile with Cosmetic Dentistry and Teeth Whitening, which can address imperfections like gaps, misalignment, discoloration, and even a gummy smile, for a more confident and radiant appearance.


### Beautiful Porcelain Crowns and Veneers


Our experienced dentists specialize in porcelain veneers, crowns, and correcting imperfections like discoloration, gaps, chips, and misalignment. Contact us for in-person free cosmetic consultations.


### Straighten Your Teeth with Invisalign®


Invisalign provides a comfortable and removable alternative to traditional metal braces. As a trusted Invisalign provider, Oceanic Dental offers personalized cosmetic consultations to assess your suitability for Invisalign treatment.


## Restorative Dentistry



### Full-Mouth Restoration


Full-mouth restoration encompasses a comprehensive array of procedures, including treatment for gum disease, fillings, crowns, dental implants, dentures, and straightening, to achieve your desired results.


### Root Canal Therapy


Our Board-Certified Endodontic Specialist performs root canal therapy in our office to save infected teeth. We use the latest dental technology for a more comfortable and thorough procedure.


### Extractions & Wisdom Teeth


If a tooth has sustained significant damage, it may need to be extracted. Our in-house oral surgeon uses gentle extraction techniques and provides IV sedation for those who prefer to sleep during the procedure.

# Invisalign® - Straighten Up with a Smile


As a Certified Gold Invisalign Provider in Orange County, Oceanic Dental offers expert, discreet, and effective teeth straightening in Huntington Beach, Fountain Valley, Costa Mesa and surrounding areas. Enjoy personalized, concierge-level care throughout the entire process, ensuring your treatment is tailored to your lifestyle for effective and inconspicuous results.

Special Event


## Invisalign Day


A heartfelt thank you to everyone who joined us for Invisalign Day! 🌸 It was a joy seeing so many of you take a step toward your best smile. If you weren’t able to attend, don’t worry—just reach out. We’d still love to help you get started and will make sure you receive the most valuable treatment options available. Your smile journey is always welcome here.

Warmly,

‍The Oceanic Dental Team

Request A Consultation

What’s Invisalign


## Invisalign Magic: The Perks


Invisalign is a modern and discreet way to straighten your teeth without the hassle of traditional braces. Using clear, removable aligners, Invisalign gradually shifts your teeth into place, giving you a beautifully aligned smile. As a Gold Invisalign Provider in Orange County (among the first Invisalign providers in Fountain Valley, Costa Mesa, and Huntington Beach), our Certified experts ensure a comfortable and personalized experience from start to finish.

Invisible and Comfortable: Clear aligners that are virtually invisible and smooth, ensuring a comfortable fit without metal brackets or wires.

Removable and Convenient: Easily removable for eating, brushing, and flossing, allowing you to maintain oral hygiene and enjoy your favorite foods.

Customized and Effective: Custom-made aligners using advanced 3D imaging for a precise, effective, and tailored treatment plan.

The Process - Let's Break It Down


## The Clear Path to Your Dream Smile



###### Step 1: Consultation and Digital Impressions


Start with a free consultation to meet our friendly orthodontists, discuss your smile goals, and take digital impressions. Using advanced 3D imaging, we create a custom treatment plan and show you a preview of your new smile.


###### Step 2: Custom Aligner Creation and Fitting


Your custom Invisalign aligners are made from your digital impressions. These clear, comfortable aligners gradually shift your teeth. You’ll wear each set for about two weeks. Our team ensures a perfect fit and provides easy care instructions.


###### Step 3: Regular Check-Ins


We’ll schedule regular check-ins to monitor your progress and make adjustments as needed. Most treatments take 12 months or more, but you’ll see improvements in just a few weeks. Our goal is to keep your treatment on track and achieve the best results.


### Why Choose Oceanic Dental for Invisalign


At Oceanic Dental, we’re committed to providing top-tier Invisalign® treatments across Orange County (Huntington Beach, Fountain Valley, Costa Mesa, and beyond) with expertise, precision, and personalized care.


#### Certified Gold Invisalign Provider


Recognized since 2020 for delivering exceptional Invisalign results.


#### Advanced 3D Scanning Technology


iTero Lumina digital impressions ensure precision, comfort, and faster results.


#### Personalized Treatment Plans


Tailored solutions designed to fit your unique smile goals and lifestyle.


#### Trusted by the Community


A leading provider for Invisalign in Huntington Beach, Fountain Valley, Costa Mesa and beyond.


## FAQs


Find answers to commonly asked questions about Invisalign.

How long does Invisalign treatment take?

Treatment duration varies depending on your individual needs, but most treatments take 12 to 18 months for adults. For teens, it may take slightly longer, averaging 18 to 24 months.

How much does Invisalign cost?

The cost of Invisalign usually ranges from $3,000 to $8,000, depending on the complexity of the case and the length of treatment. Factors like insurance coverage and the specific orthodontic issues being addressed can affect the overall price.

Can I eat and drink with Invisalign aligners on?

No, you should remove your aligners before eating or drinking anything other than water. This helps prevent staining and damage to the aligners. Always brush your teeth before putting them back in​.

Will Invisalign affect my speech?

Some people may experience a slight lisp or speech adjustment when they first start wearing aligners, but this typically goes away within a week as you get used to them.

How often do I need to wear Invisalign aligners?

For the best results, you should wear your Invisalign aligners for 20 to 22 hours a day, only removing them to eat, drink, brush, and floss. Wearing them consistently helps ensure your treatment stays on track and you achieve your desired results within the expected timeframe​.

# Root Canal Therapy


Discover the comfort of pain-free root canal therapy and keep your natural smile intact with our expert dental care. Our gentle approach ensures a worry-free experience for preserving your oral health and beautiful smile.


### Root Canal Therapy: Saving Your Tooth and Preserving Oral Health


Root canal therapy is a procedure performed to save an infected tooth. By removing the infected tissue, cleaning and disinfecting the inside of the tooth, and filling it with sterile material, we can prevent the need for extraction and preserve your oral health.


###### Why Choose Root Canal Therapy?


- Removes infected tissue

- Cleans and disinfects the inside of the tooth


###### The Benefits


- Saves infected tooth

- Prevents extraction

- Preserves oral health


### Highly Experienced Root Canal Specialist


Dr. Samar Hubbi, our amazing Endodontist and highly experienced root canal specialist, has completed extensive training in Endodontics. With over three thousand successful root canal and oral surgery procedures, you can definitely trust in his expertise.


###### Why Choose Us


- Extensive training in Endodontics

- Over three thousand successful procedures


###### Our Success


- High success rates

- Prolonged oral health and saved teeth


### Signs You Need a Root Canal


If you're experiencing severe tooth pain, swelling, or discoloration, you may need a root canal, but don't worry, our skilled team will remove the infection and restore your tooth, providing lasting relief and preserving your oral health.


###### Severe Pain


Tooth pain, swelling, abscess, discoloration, or gum swelling may indicate the need for a root canal.


###### Discoloration


Darkening or yellowing of a tooth may be a sign that a root canal is necessary.


## FAQs


Find answers to commonly asked questions about root canal therapy.

Does a root canal hurt?

A root canal is generally not painful. Modern techniques and local anesthesia ensure that the procedure is comfortable. Many patients report that it feels similar to getting a filling. You may experience some sensitivity after the procedure, but it typically subsides within a few days.

How long does a root canal take?

A typical root canal procedure takes about 60 to 90 minutes, depending on the complexity of the case. In some instances, multiple visits may be necessary, especially if the infection is severe or the tooth requires additional treatment.

How much does a root canal cost?

The cost of a root canal varies depending on the tooth being treated and the complexity of the case. On average, it ranges from $700 to $1,500 per tooth. During your consultation, we’ll provide a detailed cost estimate and discuss any available payment options.

Will I need a crown after a root canal?

In most cases, a crown is recommended after a root canal to protect the tooth and restore its strength and functionality. After the infection is removed, the tooth may become brittle and more susceptible to breaking. A crown provides added protection and longevity.

What happens if I don’t get a root canal?

If an infected or damaged tooth is left untreated, the infection can spread to surrounding teeth and even to other parts of your body, potentially leading to more serious health issues. In addition, the tooth may eventually die, requiring extraction.

# Cosmetic Dentistry


Discover the power of a radiant smile at Oceanic Dental. Our cosmetic (or we prefer to call it aesthetic) dental services are designed to enhance not only the beauty of your smile but also its health and functionality. Whether you're looking to brighten, straighten, or reshape your teeth, our expert team is here to help you achieve the confident, beautiful smile you deserve.


# Crafting Your Radiant Smile


We offer a range of cosmetic dentistry procedures, from porcelain veneers to teeth whitening, to enhance your smile and boost your confidence.


### Porcelain Veneers & Crowns


Porcelain veneers are thin shells that cover the front of a tooth, addressing cosmetic concerns in two visits. Crowns, made from porcelain or a combination of porcelain and metal, provide full coverage and support for damaged, discolored, or weakened teeth.


### Dental Bonding


Bonding refers to the application of a tooth-colored resin to correct imperfections or enhance the shape of teeth. This procedure is often a favorable choice for cosmetic dental enhancements.


### Teeth Whitening


We provide in-house teeth whitening services using Zoom and Opalescence Boost, as well as offering professional-strength whitening kits.


### Dental Implants


Losing teeth can greatly affect not only the appearance of your smile, but also your overall oral health. For a reliable solution, we strongly recommend dental implants. Our team has extensive expertise in the precise placement of dental implants.


### Teeth straightening with Invisalign


With Invisalign clear aligners, teeth can be effectively and discreetly straightened. The comfortable plastic aligner trays are removable for brushing, flossing, and special occasions.


### Gum & Enamel Re-contouring


Gum re-contouring can improve an uneven gum line or a "gummy" smile. Enamel recontouring shapes natural teeth for a better appearance by removing small amounts of enamel to alter length, shape, or surface contours.

## FAQs


Find answers to commonly asked questions about cosmetic dentistry.

What is cosmetic dentistry?

Cosmetic dentistry focuses on improving the appearance of your teeth, gums, and smile. Popular treatments include teeth whitening, veneers, bonding, crowns, and orthodontic solutions like Invisalign. These procedures enhance aesthetics, giving you a brighter, more confident smile.

How much does cosmetic dentistry cost?

Costs vary depending on the procedure. For example, teeth whitening may cost $200-$600, while veneers or crowns can range from $1,200 to $2,500 per tooth. We will provide a personalized estimate during your consultation, and flexible payment options may be available.

Is cosmetic dentistry covered by insurance?

Most cosmetic procedures, such as teeth whitening and veneers, are not covered by insurance because they are considered elective. However, if a procedure improves function (e.g., crowns or orthodontics), partial coverage may apply. We’ll help you verify your insurance benefits.

How long do cosmetic dental treatments last?

Longevity depends on the treatment and your oral care routine. For example, professional teeth whitening results can last up to a year, while veneers and crowns can last 10-15 years or longer with proper care. At Oceanic Dental, all procedures are done with your comfort and safety in mind, using advanced techniques and high-quality materials to ensure long-lasting, beautiful results.

Can cosmetic dentistry fix chipped or uneven teeth?

Yes, cosmetic dentistry offers several solutions for chipped or uneven teeth, including veneers, bonding, or crowns. We’ll recommend the best option for your specific case during your consultation.

Its unique PF formula with potassium nitrate and fluoride helps reduce sensitivity and strengthen enamel.

## Teeth Whitening FAQs


Find answers to commonly asked questions about teeth whitening.

How does teeth whitening work?

Teeth whitening works by using bleaching agents to remove stains and discoloration from the surface of the teeth. The bleaching agents penetrate the enamel and break down the molecules that cause discoloration, resulting in a brighter smile.

Is teeth whitening safe?

Yes, teeth whitening is safe when performed by a dental professional. At Oceanic Dental, we use safe and effective whitening treatments that are tailored to your specific needs, ensuring optimal results without causing harm to your teeth or gums.

How long does it last?

Results can last from several months to a few years, depending on your oral hygiene and dietary habits. Avoiding foods and drinks that stain, like coffee and red wine, can help maintain your results longer​.

Will teeth whitening cause sensitivity?

Some individuals may experience temporary tooth sensitivity after teeth whitening. However, our dental professionals take measures to minimize sensitivity and ensure your comfort during the treatment process.

How much does teeth whitening cost?

The cost of teeth whitening can vary based on the method used. Professional in-office treatments typically range from $500 to $600 per session, while at-home kits provided by dentists can cost between $300 and $400. Over-the-counter whitening products are generally less expensive but may take longer to achieve desired results.

Why is teeth whitening so expensive?

Teeth whitening may seem like a big investment at first, but it’s worth looking at what you’re truly getting. At Oceanic Dental, both our Huntington Beach and Fountain Valley locations use high-quality materials and professional-grade systems, all under the care of skilled dental experts to give you a noticeably brighter smile that lasts—from several months to even a few years, depending on your habits, diet, and oral care routine.

Think of it this way: it’s not much more than a hair and makeup session that lasts just one night—except your radiant smile stays with you much longer and gives your confidence a real, lasting lift. It’s more than cosmetic—it’s a feel-good investment in you.

# Full-Mouth Reconstruction


At Oceanic Dental, we specialize in full mouth reconstruction, a comprehensive approach to restoring your smile to its full health, beauty, and function. Whether your smile has deteriorated due to decay, injury, or other factors, our team is here to rejuvenate your facial structure and enhance your overall quality of life. Rediscover your self-assurance with a comprehensive full-mouth restoration that will elevate the appearance of your smile and give you the confidence to showcase your beautiful, healthy teeth to the world.


### Rediscover Your Self-Assurance with Full-Mouth Restoration


Full mouth restoration, also known as full mouth rehab or restoration, is a customized treatment plan designed to address extensive dental issues such as tooth loss, decay, and bite alignment problems. Led by expert prosthodontist Dr. Mamoru Tanaka, we specialize in restoring function, aesthetics, and confidence with advanced treatment options including implant-supported restorations, All-on-4 solutions, and more.


### Personalized Diagnosis and Treatment Plan


This isn’t a one-size-fits-all solution; it’s a personalized plan that combines various dental treatments to fit your specific needs. Whether it’s fixing cavities, replacing missing teeth, or aligning your bite, full mouth restoration takes a comprehensive approach to rejuvenate your smile and boost your confidence. Our skilled team at Oceanic Dental is here to guide you every step of the way, ensuring your smile is healthy, beautiful, and fully functional.


### Full-Mouth Reconstruction Treatments



### Gum Disease Treatment


Addressing periodontal issues to ensure a healthy foundation for your teeth.


### Dental Fillings and Crowns


Repairing and strengthening damaged or decayed teeth.


### Dental Implants and Dentures


Replacing missing teeth for a complete and functional smile.


### Full-Mouth Reconstruction


Restoring the appearance and function of your teeth with durable and natural-looking materials.


### Orthodontics


Using Invisalign or traditional braces to correct alignment issues.


### Root Canal Therapy and Extractions


Treating infections and removing severely damaged teeth.


### Full-Mouth Restoration in One Location


We offer comprehensive dental services all in one location, so you don’t need to visit multiple specialists. Our team handles everything from cleanings and fillings to complex full mouth reconstructions. Enjoy the convenience and comfort of having all your dental needs met under one roof, ensuring a smooth and efficient experience for every patient.


### Full-Mouth Restoration Process



### Emergency and Priority Treatments


Addressing any urgent dental issues such as gum disease or decayed teeth.


### Restorative Procedures


Implementing treatments like fillings, crowns, and implants to rebuild your teeth's structure and function.


### Cosmetic Enhancements


Completing the transformation with aesthetic treatments to achieve a beautiful, natural-looking smile.


### All-on-X Dental Implants with Dr. Tanaka


Dr. Tanaka specializes in All-on-X solutions, a revolutionary approach to full-mouth restoration. All-on-X uses just 4-6 strategically placed dental implants to support a full arch of fixed, natural-looking replacement teeth. This advanced technique offers a stable, long-lasting solution for patients who are missing most or all of their teeth.


#### Immediate Results


In many cases, you can leave the office with a fully restored smile the same day.


#### Natural Look and Feel


The closest experience to natural teeth in terms of appearance, feel, and function.


#### Long-Lasting Solution


Can last a lifetime, offering a durable and reliable tooth replacement option.


#### No More Removable Dentures


Provide a secure, non-removable alternative for full-arch tooth replacement.


## FAQs


Find answers to commonly asked questions about full-mouth reconstruction.

What is full mouth reconstruction?

Full mouth reconstruction involves a combination of restorative and cosmetic procedures to rebuild or replace all teeth in your mouth. It improves both the function and appearance of your smile, addressing issues like damaged, decayed, or missing teeth.

Who is a candidate for full mouth restoration?

Candidates typically have multiple oral health problems, such as significant tooth loss, extensive decay, severe wear, or jaw issues. Full mouth restoration is also ideal for those with genetic conditions or those who've experienced traumatic damage to their teeth.

How long does full mouth reconstruction take?

The process can take several months, depending on the complexity of your case. This includes time for planning, healing (especially if implants are involved), and performing the necessary procedures. Your dentist will provide a timeline during your consultation.

How much does full mouth reconstruction cost?

The cost varies significantly based on the procedures needed, ranging from $20,000 to $60,000, and in some cases $100,000 or more. Factors such as dental implants, crowns, and orthodontic work can influence the total cost. A detailed estimate will be provided after a thorough evaluation.

Will I need to visit multiple specialists for full mouth reconstruction?

In many cases, a team of dental specialists, such as prosthodontists, periodontists, and orthodontists, may collaborate on your treatment plan. At Oceanic Dental, however, we offer all the necessary expertise under one roof, streamlining the process for you.

# Tooth Extractions &Wisdom Teeth Removal


At Oceanic Dental, we prioritize saving your natural teeth whenever possible. Our experienced dentists will attempt to repair a damaged or decayed tooth with a filling, crown, or other treatments. However, when a tooth is beyond repair, a gentle extraction may be necessary.


### Gentle Tooth Extractions for Fast Healing


Our dental surgeon, with over 30 years of experience, performs tooth extractions with precision and care, ensuring your comfort throughout the process.

Whether due to severe decay, damage, or overcrowding, our experienced dental team uses the latest techniques to make extractions as smooth and painless as possible.

We focus on minimizing discomfort and promoting quick healing to help you return to your daily activities as soon as possible.


### Socket Preservation and Bone Grafting


Following an extraction, socket preservation is crucial to maintain the health and structure of your jawbone​.

Socket Preservation: To prevent bone loss and speed up healing after an extraction, we perform socket preservation. This involves filling the empty socket with bone grafting material or a collagen plug. This step helps prevent bone loss, supports the surrounding teeth, and prepares the site for potential future dental implants​.

Benefits of Bone Grafting: Bone grafting stabilizes the jaw and maintains facial structure. It reduces the risk of complications like dry socket and enhances the overall healing process​


### Gentle Wisdom Tooth Removal


Wisdom teeth, also known as third molars, typically show up in the late teens or early twenties. If they get stuck, blocked by other teeth, they can really be a pain and cause some trouble for your jaw and surrounding teeth.

Our friendly and skilled team uses the latest extraction techniques and advanced technology to carefully remove wisdom teeth, making sure to keep you comfortable afterwards and promote quick healing. We're here to provide a worry-free experience, and to help you keep your oral health in top shape.


## FAQs


Find answers to commonly asked questions about tooth extractions.

Why do I need a tooth extraction?

A tooth extraction may be necessary if the tooth is severely decayed, damaged, or infected beyond repair. It's also recommended if there's overcrowding or if a tooth is at risk of causing further dental issues. Wisdom teeth, in particular, are often removed if they are impacted or causing pain.

Is a tooth extraction painful?

The procedure itself is not painful, as local anesthesia is used to numb the area. You may experience some discomfort or swelling after the procedure, but this can be managed with pain medication and proper aftercare. The discomfort usually subsides within a few days.

How long does it take to recover from a tooth extraction?

Recovery generally takes about 1-2 weeks, during which time you may experience some swelling, bruising, and mild pain. It’s important to follow your dentist’s post-op instructions, including avoiding certain foods and maintaining oral hygiene, to ensure a smooth recovery.

When should wisdom teeth be removed?

Wisdom teeth are often removed between the ages of 17 and 25, especially if they are impacted, causing pain, or risking future dental problems. Your dentist will take X-rays to determine if removal is necessary before problems arise.

What are the risks of not removing impacted wisdom teeth?

Impacted wisdom teeth can lead to infection, cyst formation, damage to surrounding teeth, and increased risk of decay and gum disease. If they don't have enough space to emerge properly, it’s often recommended to remove them to avoid future complications.

## Cleanings & Gum Disease Treatment



# Dental Cleanings & Gum Disease Treatment in Huntington Beach & Fountain Valley


At Oceanic Dental, we are dedicated to ensuring the long-term health of your teeth and gums. We offer thorough cleanings and expert gum disease treatments, along with helpful resources for at-home dental care. We help you keep your teeth and gums healthy for life.


## Why Patients Trust Oceanic Dental For Dental Cleaning Services



### Gentle and Thorough Cleanings


Our hygienists are highly trained and experienced, providing thorough yet gentle cleanings with the latest high-tech equipment. They take the time to ensure each patient feels comfortable and relaxed during their visit.


### Advanced Cleaning Tools for Effective Treatment


We use ultrasonic scalers to gently remove hard mineral deposits, stains, and tartar from your teeth and gums. These high-frequency sound waves effectively clean without any discomfort, making your visit faster and much more comfortable.


## Patient Education for Better Oral Care


Our hygienists love to help you learn about taking care of your teeth and gums. They'll show you the best way to brush and floss and give you great tips for keeping your mouth healthy at home.


## Convenient Hours to Fit Your Schedule


Our office is open one Saturday a month by appointment, and we have at least two friendly hygienists ready to accommodate your schedule from 9 AM to 3 PM. We're here to make sure your visits are as convenient as possible.


## What’s Included in a Routine Dental Cleaning



## The Routine Dental Cleaning Process


Our cleanings are designed for comfort, effectiveness, and prevention.


##### Comprehensive Exam


We begin with a thorough evaluation of your teeth and gums, often supported by x-rays to spot hidden issues early.


##### Plaque & Tartar Removal


Using specialized tools, we gently remove buildup above and below the gumline to reduce inflammation and prevent disease.


##### Polishing & Fluoride


Your teeth are polished to remove surface stains and leave a clean, smooth finish. Fluoride may be applied to strengthen enamel.


##### Oral Hygiene Guidance


We tailor brushing, flossing, and at-home care tips to your specific needs to help you maintain a healthier smile between visits.


## Signs You Might Need Gum Disease Treatment


Early signs of gum disease are easy to miss. If you notice any of the following, it’s time to schedule a periodontal evaluation. Catching these symptoms early allows us to treat the condition before it worsens


### Red, Swollen, or Bleeding Gums


It's a sign that inflammation is present and your gum tissue may be infected


### Persistent Bad Breath


Caused by bacteria buildup under the gums


### Gum Recession or Loose Teeth


Indicating bone loss and advanced periodontal damage


### Sensitivity When Chewing


Often related to gum detachment or exposed roots


## Our Gum Disease Treatment



### High-tech and Comfortable Treatment for Gum Disease


Our certified hygienists use the latest laser technology to effectively treat mild to moderate gum disease. With deep cleanings and soft tissue diode lasers, we provide comfortable and long-lasting results. Experience less bleeding, swelling, tissue damage, and discomfort, and enjoy a fast recovery.


### Effective Removal of Diseased Tissue and Bacteria


Our hygienists use hand instruments, ultrasonic scalers, and soft tissue lasers to gently remove diseased tissue and bacteria that cause gum disease. Laser Gum Disease Treatment offers benefits such as minimal bleeding, little swelling, fast recovery, and reduced discomfort.


### Eliminating Bacteria with Arestin Antibiotic


Arestin is a prescription antibiotic used to help eliminate bacteria that has collected in gum pockets and can’t be easily reached. After scaling and planning, Arestin is placed directly in the deeper pockets. Over a period of days, the antibiotic dissolves and kills the bacteria collected in the pocket.


### Preventing Severe Gum Disease and Health Issues


When plaque has been building up too long without any treatment, the threat to your teeth is much more acute. It can destroy bone that holds the teeth as well as surrounding soft tissue. Severe gum disease is also associated with other health issues, such as heart disease, strokes and more.


## What is Deep Cleaning?



## Deep Cleaning (Scaling & Root Planing)


If gum disease has progressed, we may recommend scaling and root planing. This deep cleaning procedure: (1) Removes plaque and bacteria below the gumline; (2) Smooths root surfaces to help gums reattach; (3) Is often done with local anesthetic for your comfort


## Patients typically notice healthier gums and fresher breath soon after treatment. We’ll also schedule maintenance visits to keep everything stable long term.



## FAQs


Find answers to commonly asked questions about cleaning and gum diseases.

How often should I get a dental cleaning?

We recommend a cleaning every six months to maintain good oral health. However, if you have gum disease or other oral health issues, more frequent cleanings may be advised.

What’s the difference between a regular cleaning and a deep cleaning?

A regular cleaning (prophylaxis) focuses on removing plaque and tartar from above the gum line. A deep cleaning (scaling and root planing) goes beneath the gum line to remove tartar and bacteria from the tooth roots, especially for patients with gum disease.

Is a deep cleaning painful?

Deep cleaning is typically performed under local anesthesia, so you won’t feel pain during the procedure. You may experience some soreness or sensitivity afterward, but this usually subsides within a few days. The full healing of the gums can take several weeks. Follow-up care and good oral hygiene are essential for proper healing​

What are the early signs of gum disease?

Early signs of gum disease, also known as gingivitis, include red, swollen, or bleeding gums. If untreated, it can progress to periodontitis, which can cause tooth loss and damage to the bone supporting your teeth​.

Can gum disease be reversed?

In its early stages (gingivitis), gum disease can be reversed with proper treatment and improved oral hygiene. However, advanced gum disease (periodontitis) can only be managed, not fully cured, but treatments can prevent it from worsening.

# Composite Tooth-Colored Fillings


Composite fillings are a long-lasting and reliable option that offers excellent reinforcement for your teeth. They are effective in fixing minor chips, cracks, and cavities, and are suitable for both adults and children, ensuring the preservation of a healthy and attractive smile.

Preserve Your Beautiful, Healthy Smile


## Enhance Your Smile with Composite Tooth-Colored Fillings


Composite fillings offer a natural appearance, blending seamlessly with your existing teeth. They are made from a durable material that provides long-lasting support for your teeth.


### Natural Appearance


Match your natural tooth color, making them virtually invisible​


### Durability and Strength


Strong and long-lasting, effectively restoring tooth function and resisting wear


### Conservative Treatment


Preserve your natural tooth. Safe for Adults and Children


### Quick and Pain-Free Process


Resume Your Daily Activities Immediately

How It Works?


## The Composite Filling Process


Our procedure for applying composite fillings is straightforward and patient friendly. This process is typically completed in one visit, allowing you to leave with a restored, natural-looking smile. At Oceanic Dental, we prioritize your comfort and satisfaction, making us a premier choice for dental care in Orange County​


##### Consultation


We begin with a thorough examination to determine the need for a filling


##### Preparation


Local anesthesia is administered to ensure comfort, and any decay is carefully removed


##### Bonding


The tooth is prepared with a bonding agent, and the composite material is applied in layers, each hardened with a curing light​


##### Shaping and Polishing


The filling is sculpted to match your tooth's natural contours and polished for a smooth finish


## FAQs


Find answers to commonly asked questions about Composite Tooth-Colored Fillings.

What are composite tooth-colored fillings?

Composite fillings are made from a tooth-colored resin material that blends seamlessly with your natural teeth. They are used to repair cavities, cracks, or chips, offering a more aesthetic alternative to traditional metal (amalgam) fillings.

How long do composite fillings last?

Composite fillings can last 5 to 10 years or longer with proper oral hygiene and regular dental checkups. Their longevity depends on factors like the size of the filling, the location, and how well you maintain your teeth.

Are composite fillings safe and do they look natural?

Yes, composite fillings are safe and mercury-free. They are made from a durable resin material and are often preferred for their natural look and biocompatibility. They are color-matched to your tooth, making them virtually invisible and blending seamlessly with your smile.

How much do composite fillings cost?

The cost of composite fillings varies depending on the size and location of the cavity, but they typically range from $100 to $300 per tooth. We’ll provide a detailed estimate during your consultation, and insurance may cover a portion of the cost.

How long does it take to get a composite filling?

A composite filling procedure usually takes about 30 to 60 minutes, depending on the size of the cavity. The dentist will clean the area, place the composite material, shape it, and harden it with a special light.

Stress-Free Dental Care with Sedation Dentistry

Our experienced team will provide you with medication that helps you relax and feel comfortable during your appointment, allowing you to receive the dental care you need without any discomfort. Whether you're having a simple cleaning or a more complex procedure, our sedation dentistry options will ensure a stress-free experience.

Anxiety-Free Dental Visits: Feel calm and relaxed during your dental visits, eliminating stress and fear.

Pain-Free Treatments: Minimize discomfort and pain during procedures, making treatments more pleasant.

Efficient Care: Complete multiple procedures in one visit, saving time and reducing the need for repeated appointments.

Whether you need just a bit of nitrous oxide (laughing gas) for a light procedure, a pill for moderate relaxation, or IV sedation for deeper comfort, we’ve got you covered. Your comfort is our priority, and we’ll ensure everything is set up for a smooth experience.

Genuine Comfort: We prioritize your comfort and make sure every visit feels like a breeze. Our sedation options are all about making you feel relaxed and cared for.

## FAQs


Find answers to commonly asked questions about sedation dentistry.

What is sedation dentistry?

Sedation dentistry involves the use of medication to help patients relax during dental procedures. It can range from minimal sedation (feeling calm but fully awake) to moderate sedation, where patients may feel drowsy or even fall asleep but can still respond to instructions.

Is sedation dentistry safe?

Yes, sedation dentistry is generally safe when administered by a trained professional. Dentists will carefully review your medical history and monitor you throughout the procedure to ensure safety. However, certain conditions, such as pregnancy or specific medical issues, may affect eligibility​.

What types of sedation are available?

There are several types of sedation, including:

‍Nitrous oxide (laughing gas): Inhaled to create a calm feeling and wears off quickly.

‍Oral sedation: A pill taken before the procedure to relax you.

‍IV sedation: Administered through the veins for deeper relaxation, often making patients feel like they slept through the procedure

Will I feel pain with sedation dentistry?

While sedation helps reduce anxiety, it doesn't block pain on its own. Your dentist will usually pair sedation with a local anesthetic to ensure a pain-free experience.

How much does sedation dentistry cost?

The cost varies depending on the type of sedation used and the length of your procedure. Nitrous oxide tends to be the most affordable, while IV sedation is more expensive. Costs can range from $200 to $1,000 or more, depending on the sedation type and duration of your procedure.

## FAQs


Find answers to commonly asked questions about our new patient exam process.

What happens during a new patient exam?

During a new patient exam, we conduct a thorough assessment of your oral health, including a detailed review of your medical and dental history. This exam typically includes X-rays, Intraoral scans, a teeth cleaning, and an evaluation of your gums, teeth, and bite. We will also discuss any concerns or dental goals you may have.

How long does a new patient exam take?

A new patient exam usually takes between 60 to 90 minutes, depending on your individual needs and whether any additional procedures (like additional X-rays, oral screenings, or cleanings) are performed during the visit.

Do I need to bring anything to my first appointment?

Yes, please bring a valid ID, your dental insurance card (if applicable), and a list of any medications you are currently taking. If you have previous dental records or X-rays, it can be helpful to bring them as well.

Will my insurance cover the new patient exam?

Most dental insurance plans cover the cost of a new patient exam, including X-rays and cleanings, as part of preventive care. We can help verify your insurance coverage before your visit and provide any details regarding your benefits.

What if I need additional treatment after the exam?

If your exam reveals the need for additional treatment (such as fillings, crowns, or other restorative procedures), we will provide a detailed treatment plan and explain your options. We can also schedule follow-up appointments to complete the necessary treatments.

# Long-Lasting Dental Implants for a Confident Smile


We know missing teeth can affect your confidence and oral health. Dental implants are a durable solution to restore your smile. From single-tooth replacements to full-mouth solutions like All-on-4, our Huntington Beach and Fountain Valley specialists use advanced technology for results that last.

Dental Implants at Oceanic Dental


## Restore Your Smile and Regain Confidence with Dental Implants


At Oceanic Dental, getting dental implants is simpler and more comfortable than you might think. Our friendly team, including our expert prosthodontist and oral surgeon, takes the time to understand your needs. From checking your oral health and bone structure to considering your smile goals, we make sure your implants fit perfectly and feel just right.

We use advanced tech like CBCT scans and digital tools to make the process smooth and precise. With high-quality materials and careful planning, your implants will not only look natural but also work just like your real teeth. You’ll be able to smile, eat, and speak with confidence again!

From start to finish, we’re here to support you with care that’s personalized, modern, and reliable. At Oceanic Dental, we don’t just focus on teeth—we’re all about helping you feel great and love your smile again!


## Why Choose Oceanic Dental for Implants?


With our trusted team and advanced technology, you can expect care that’s tailored to your needs every step of the way. Here’s why we’re your top choice for dental implants:

Specialized Team: Work with Dr. Tanaka (Prosthodontist) and Dr. Noh (Oral Surgeon) under one roof for seamless care.

Proven Excellence: Recognized in the OC Register’s People’s Choice Awards, with over 1,900 5-star reviews across platforms.

Advanced Technology: We use 3D digital imaging, CBCT scans, and AI-assisted diagnostics to plan every case precisely.

Comfort-Focused Care: Sedation options and a gentle approach help ensure a stress-free experience from start to finish.

Superior Materials: We use E-max veneers, which are thinner, stronger, and more durable than traditional veneers. They resist chips, fractures, and stains, ensuring your smile stays beautiful longer.

Expert Solutions for Dark Teeth: For very dark teeth, we use Zirconia covered in clear porcelain to effectively mask discoloration while maintaining a natural look.

Expertise: Our lead dentist, Dr. Pham is an expert in cosmetic dentistry. She is a member of the American Academy of Cosmetic Dentistry and taught at UCSF School of Dentistry which is widely regarded as a top dental school.


## Dental Implant Options


We offer a full range of implant solutions tailored to your needs:


### Single-Tooth Implants


Replace one missing tooth with a natural-looking and permanent solution.


### Implant Bridges


Secure multiple missing teeth without relying on neighboring teeth.


### All-on-4 or All-on-X Implants


Restore your entire upper or lower arch using 4 to 6 implants to support a full set of teeth—stable, beautiful, and long-lasting.


### Snap-On Implant Dentures


Removable dentures anchored with implants for added security and comfort.

The Implant Journey: What to Expect


## Our Comprehensive Process for Successful Dental Implants



###### Consultation and Planning


Start with a free consultation where you'll meet our in-house specialists, take photos, and discuss your dental needs. We evaluate your teeth, review treatment options, and answer all your questions. Using X-rays and detailed planning, we ensure your implants will be perfectly integrated and secured to your jawbone.


###### Implant Placement


We surgically place the titanium implant into your jawbone, creating a stable foundation for your new tooth. After the implant is placed, we allow time for it to integrate with the bone, ensuring a secure fit.


###### Abutment and Crown Placement


Once the implant has healed, we attach the abutment and custom-made crown. This final step restores the natural look and function of your tooth, completing your smile transformation.


## All-on-X Dental Implants with Dr. Tanaka


Dr. Tanaka - Oceanic Dental's prosthodontist in Fountain Valley - specializes in All-on-X solutions, a revolutionary approach to full-mouth restoration. All-on-X uses just 4-6 strategically placed dental implants to support a full arch of fixed, natural-looking replacement teeth. This advanced technique offers a stable, long-lasting solution for patients who are missing most or all of their teeth.


#### Immediate Results


In many cases, you can leave the office with a fully restored smile the same day.


#### Natural Look and Feel


The closest experience to natural teeth in terms of appearance, feel, and function.


#### Long-Lasting Solution


Can last a lifetime, offering a durable and reliable tooth replacement option.


#### No More Removable Dentures


Provide a secure, non-removable alternative for full-arch tooth replacement.


## Flexible Financing Options



#### Affordable Financing


Choose a payment plan that fits your budget and schedule.


#### No Hard Credit Check


No traditional credit check required.


#### Convenient


Easy auto-pay setup. No late fee.


#### Lightening Fast


Know if you are qualified and start your needed treatment within minutes.

Apply Now


## FAQs


Find answers to commonly asked questions about dental implant.

How much do dental implants cost in Orange County?

The cost of dental implants can range from $3,000 to $6,000 per tooth, depending on the complexity of the procedure and any additional treatments, like bone grafting. Multi-tooth implants, such as implant-supported bridges or full arch replacements (like All-on-4), can cost significantly more.

Is All-on-X better than traditional dentures?

Yes—All-on-X offers a permanent, secure, and natural-feeling solution using 4–6 implants to support a full arch. No adhesives, no slipping.

Who is a good candidate for All-on-4 dental implants?

Patients missing most or all teeth who have sufficient bone or are eligible for bone grafts are ideal candidates. A consultation with our prosthodontist can confirm.

How long does the implant process take?

Single implants typically require 3–6 months including healing. All-on-X cases may offer same-day temporary teeth with full healing over several months.

What if I need extractions or bone grafting?

We provide all treatments in-house, including gentle extractions, bone grafts, and socket preservation—so you don’t need to be referred out.

What’s the success rate of dental implants?

With proper planning and care, dental implants have a 95–98% success rate and can last decades—or a lifetime.

Are dental implants painful?

Most patients say it's easier than expected. We use local anesthesia or sedation for your comfort, and healing is usually mild.

Can I get implants in one day?

Yes. We offer same-day implant placement in select cases including All-on-X, allowing you to walk out with new teeth the same day.

Will my insurance cover implants?

Dental implant coverage depends on your insurance plan. While many dental insurance plans don’t fully cover implants, they may cover portions like extractions or crowns. Medical insurance might help if the implant is necessary due to an injury. We can help check with your provider and verify your coverage.

Why choose Oceanic Dental for implants?

We’re trusted by thousands of patients, with advanced digital planning, an in-house team of specialists, and unmatched patient care from two premier locations: Huntington Beach and Fountain Valley in Orange County.

## Meet Dr. Krystal Pham


Welcome to Oceanic Dental, where Dr. Krystal Pham leads our practice with a genuine passion for transforming smiles and enhancing lives.

To Dr. Pham, a smile is much more than just a set of teeth; it's a reflection of your life’s vibrancy and joy. She believes every smile tells a story, and she’s honored to be part of that journey. Whether you're in for a routine check-up or an advanced cosmetic procedure, Dr. Pham’s goal is not just to enhance your smile but to boost your confidence and, ultimately, your overall well-being.

With over 20 years of experience, Dr. Pham’s commitment to excellence is evident in her dedication to ongoing training, patient care, and hands-on expertise—not only at her clinic but also as a Assistant Clinical Professor at the University of California, San Francisco. Her extensive background makes her not just a great dentist, but a trusted partner on your path to better oral health and a radiant smile.


## Creating Beautiful Smiles That Reflect Vibrant Lives



### Providing High-Quality Concierge Dental Care


Our journey started in 2010 with a mission: to deliver high-quality, personalized dental care with a concierge touch, combining advanced technology and comprehensive services—all in a welcoming environment in Huntington Beach. The trust and support from our community led us to open a larger clinic in Fountain Valley.

Today, we’re honored to have cared for over 15,000 patients across Orange County, from Huntington Beach to Fountain Valley, Newport Beach, Irvine and Costa Mesa to Long Beach, Santa Ana, Anaheim, Buena Park and beyond. Our commitment remains the same: to provide comprehensive, high-quality, and comfortable care, bringing out your best smile—one visit at a time.


## Our Mission: Bringing Out Your Best Smile



### Transforming Smiles, One Visit at A Time


We understand that your smile is an essential part of who you are, and we are dedicated to helping you maintain and enhance it through personalized and high-quality dental care. At Oceanic Dental, our world-class dentists and highly trained staff are committed to bringing out the best smile you deserve always with the concierge level service experience.

Our approach combines the latest dental technologies with a compassionate touch, ensuring that you receive the best possible treatment tailored to your unique needs. Whether you’re seeking preventive care, restorative treatments, or cosmetic enhancements, our team is here to support you every step of the way.

Welcome, Irvine residents!

Oceanic Dental is proud to provide top-tier dental care and personalized dental treatments to the Irvine community. Just a short drive away, our office offers a wide range of services—from regular cleanings and preventive care to advanced cosmetic and restorative treatments, tailored to your needs. With a focus on comfort and personalized attention, we’re here to help you achieve a beautiful, healthy smile.

Give us a call today to schedule your appointment!

## Every person deserves high-quality dental care!


At Oceanic Dental, we have a seamless process to help you achieve the smile you love. Our team of top-rated dentists and specialist is dedicated to providing you with the highest quality dental care and making your visit pleasant and comfortable


### In-House Specialists


Our team of dental specialists allows us to provide all services, from diagnosis to treatment, in-house, saving you the time, headaches, and extra cost of working with multiple providers.


### Knowledge & Experience


Our team brings years of experience and a dedication to personalized care. From cosmetic treatments to complex restorations, we ensure every visit is tailored to your needs and as comfortable as possible.


### Advanced Technology


Using advanced dental technologies such as 3D Introral scanners and AI-assisted diagnostics, we deliver precision dental care that’s fast, comfortable, and reliable.

Book An Appointment


# Comprehensive Dental Care Serving Irvine


Discover a full range of dental services designed to promote a healthy and beautiful smile for Irvine's residents. From routine cleanings to advanced cosmetic procedures, our team is dedicated to providing comprehensive care for your dental needs.


### General Dentistry



### Welcome to Your First Visit & New Patient Exam


Your first dental visit should not be stressful. Our welcoming staff will assist you as we take X-rays, perform a gentle examination, and create a personalized treatment plan.


### Cleanings & Gum Disease Treatment


We provide regular professional cleaning, and our in-house board-certified periodontist provides gum treatment, including gum surgery, extraction, bone graft, and implants.


### Tooth-Colored Fillings for a Natural Look


At Oceanic Dental, we offer durable composite tooth-colored fillings that closely match your teeth's natural color. Our fillings blend seamlessly with your smile, restoring your teeth to their natural beauty.


### Cosmetic Dentistry



### Cosmetic Dentistry & Teeth Whitening


Enhance your smile with Cosmetic Dentistry and Teeth Whitening, which can address imperfections like gaps, misalignment, discoloration, and even a gummy smile, for a more confident and radiant appearance.


### Beautiful Porcelain Crowns and Veneers


Our experienced dentists specialize in porcelain veneers, crowns, and correcting imperfections like discoloration, gaps, chips, and misalignment. Contact us for in-person free cosmetic consultations.


### Straighten Your Teeth with Invisalign®


Invisalign provides a comfortable and removable alternative to traditional metal braces. As a trusted Invisalign provider, Oceanic Dental offers personalized cosmetic consultations to assess your suitability for Invisalign treatment.


### Restorative Dentistry



### Full-Mouth Restoration


Full-mouth restoration encompasses a comprehensive array of procedures, including treatment for gum disease, fillings, crowns, dental implants, dentures, and straightening, to achieve your desired results.


### Root Canal Therapy


Our Board-Certified Endodontic Specialist performs root canal therapy in our office to save infected teeth. We use the latest dental technology for a more comfortable and thorough procedure.


### Tooth Extractions


If a tooth has sustained significant damage, it may need to be extracted. Our in-house oral surgeon uses gentle extraction techniques and provides IV sedation for those who prefer to sleep during the procedure.


### Sedation Dentistry


Experience relaxation with our sedation dentistry services, ensuring a comfortable dental care experience. It's like a soothing nap while we work on enhancing your smile!


### Dental Implant Services


Our specialists have 30+ years of experience with dental implants, which are permanent tooth replacements. They can be used with dentures, crowns, or bridges to restore your smile.


### All-on-X Implants


All-on-X dental implant solution replaces an entire arch of teeth with just 4 or 6 strategically placed implants, giving you a stable, long-lasting, and natural-looking smile.


## Our Team of General Practice & Specialists


Discover the exceptional care provided by our dedicated team of dental professionals, who are committed to serving the communities of Irvine with top-notch dental services and personalized attention.

Dr. Krystal Pham

Dr. Pham, with 20+ years in dentistry, is the lead dentist at Oceanic Dental. Her passion for dentistry is rooted in a family tradition of healthcare. Inspired by her mother’s practice, she saw the power of a healthy smile early on. Dr. Pham offers a wide range of services, from preventive to cosmetic and implant dentistry, always striving for excellence, compassion, and innovation.

Dr. Chris Bonin

Dr. Bonin, boasting a 30-year illustrious career, excels in surgical procedures and comprehensive mouth reconstructions. His skill set includes implant dentistry, bone grafting, and wisdom teeth extraction, with a special focus on sedation for patients with anxiety. He is a respected member of notable dental associations such as the International Congress of Oral Implantologists, the American Academy of Implant Dentistry, and the American Dental Association.

Dr. Brittany Foster

Dr. Brittany Foster is a skilled general dentist with a Doctorate of Dental Medicine from Roseman University of Health Sciences and an extensive background in cosmetic and restorative dentistry, implants, and pediatric care. Known for her gentle approach and commitment to high-quality care, Dr. Foster focuses on delivering comprehensive and personalized treatments for patients of all ages.

Dr. Mamoru Tanaka

Dr. Tanaka is a skilled prosthodontist specializing in full-mouth reconstructions. Dr. Tanaka’s passion for dentistry runs in the family, having been inspired by his father, a respected dentist in Japan. With over a decade of experience and advanced training from Tufts University, where he earned his Certificate in Advanced Prosthodontics with honors, Dr. Tanaka is committed to providing top-tier care to his patients.

Dr. Shenika Cantrell

Dr. Cantrell brings both expertise and personal insight to Oceanic Dental. With a Doctor of Dental Medicine and an MBA from Roseman College of Dental Medicine in Utah, along with her active membership in the Academy of General Dentistry, she combines advanced dental knowledge with patient-focused care.

Dr. Katy Vu

Dr. Vu is a distinguished dentist with comprehensive expertise in dentistry. Since graduating from the University of Buffalo in 2015, she has become a prominent figure in pediatric care, winning over patients with her empathetic approach. Dr. Vu’s commitment extends beyond her profession, as she is actively involved in charitable work in Haiti and the Dominican Republic. Her philanthropic efforts and steadfast dedication inspire those around her.

# Our Team of Experienced Professionals



## At Oceanic Dental, every clinical doctor and team member brings a minimum of five years of hands-on experience. Our commitment is to deliver exceptional care with the highest level of expertise, ensuring each patient receives top-quality treatment and the personalized attention they deserve.



## Dr. Krystal Pham, D.D.S.


Dr. Pham, with over 20 years of experience, is the lead dentist at Oceanic Dental. Inspired by her mother’s practice, she developed a deep appreciation for the power of a healthy smile early on. She provides comprehensive care—from preventive to cosmetic and implant dentistry—with a focus on excellence, compassion, and innovation.

She graduated with honors from the University of California, San Francisco—one of the top dental schools in the country—and is a member of the National Dental Honor Society, Omicron Kappa Upsilon. Dr. Pham also completed a residency in Implant Dentistry and later served as an Assistant Clinical Professor at UCSF.

Her dedication to patient comfort, advanced training, and personalized care has earned her recognition as one of America’s Best Dentists 2025 by the National Consumer Advisory Board and Patient’s Favorite Provider on Healthgrades.

Outside the office, she enjoys traveling, photography, and soaking up Southern California’s sunshine.


## Dr. William Noh (Oral Surgeon)


Dr. Noh is a highly trained Oral & Maxillofacial Surgeon with dual degrees in Dental Surgery and Medicine. A Southern California native, he earned his dental degree from the University of the Pacific and completed a six-year residency in oral surgery at the University of Pennsylvania, where he served as Chief Resident. He currently serves as an attending physician at Hackensack University Medical Center and Palisades Hospital, and is an active member of several respected dental and medical associations.

At Oceanic, Dr. Noh specializes in pre-prosthetic procedures, orthognathic surgery, TMJ disorders, and facial cosmetic surgery. He works closely with our prosthodontist - Dr. Tanaka, forming a seamless surgical-restorative team. With Dr. Noh handling the surgical foundation and Dr. Tanaka restoring form and function, patients benefit from a smooth, integrated treatment process and exceptional outcomes.

Known for his precision and transparent approach, Dr. Noh is deeply committed to delivering thoughtful, evidence-based care.


## Dr. Shenika Cantrell, D.D.M.


Dr. Cantrell brings both expertise and personal insight to Oceanic Dental. With a Doctor of Dental Medicine and an MBA from Roseman College of Dental Medicine in Utah, along with her active membership in the Academy of General Dentistry, she combines advanced dental knowledge with patient-focused care.

Born missing a front tooth, Dr. Cantrell understands the profound impact dental care can have on an individual’s confidence and quality of life. This experience has fueled her passion for providing personalized, compassionate care, aiming to give each patient the confident smile they deserve.

Beyond the clinic, Dr. Cantrell is an avid traveler and a fan of Disneyland, showcasing her appreciation for adventure and whimsy. This combination of professional dedication, personal empathy, and a love for life’s joys makes Dr. Cantrell not just a skilled dentist, but a truly relatable and caring healthcare provider. Her goal is always to exceed patient expectations and cultivate long-term relationships based on trust and integrity.


## Dr. Mamoru Tanaka (Prosthodontist)


Dr. Tanaka is a skilled prosthodontist specializing in full-mouth reconstructions. Dr. Tanaka’s passion for dentistry runs in the family, having been inspired by his father, a respected dentist in Japan. With over a decade of experience and advanced training from Tufts University, where he earned his Certificate in Advanced Prosthodontics with honors, Dr. Tanaka is committed to providing top-tier care to his patients.

Dr. Tanaka is a Diplomate of The American Board of Prosthodontics and a Fellow of the American College of Prosthodontists. His career has also included teaching at Boston University, where he was honored with the Best Faculty Teaching Award for Excellence in Clinical Teaching.

When he's not transforming smiles, Dr. Tanaka enjoys the great outdoors, whether it's camping, watching baseball, or spending quality time with family and friends. As an avid dog lover, you’ll often find him enjoying time with his four-legged companions.


## Dr. Liz Hoang (Periodontist)


Dr. Hoang is a board-certified periodontist with over two decades of experience in treating gum disease and providing advanced implant therapy. She earned her D.M.D. from Tufts University in Boston and completed her specialty training in Periodontics at Columbia University in New York, where she also received a Master’s in Oral Biology.

Dr. Hoang spent six years as a clinical instructor at Columbia and served on the school’s Admissions Committee, shaping future generations of dental professionals.

Her approach to care is gentle, thorough, and patient-focused. She is committed to helping patients achieve and maintain long-term oral health by providing high-quality, evidence-based treatment plans tailored to each individual’s needs.


## Dr. Samar Hubbi (Endodontist)


Dr. Hubbi, raised in New Jersey, earned her Bachelor of Science in Biomedical Engineering before pursuing dental education at the University of Medicine and Dentistry of New Jersey (UMDNJ). She completed a General Practice Residency at the VA in San Diego, California, and returned to UMDNJ for specialty training in Endodontics.

Dr. Hubbi is highly skilled in microscopic root canal therapy and surgical endodontic procedures, with a focus on anesthetic and pain control for minimal discomfort. Known for her gentle touch and friendly nature, she is a patient favorite.

In her free time, Dr. Hubbi enjoys traveling, swimming, and hiking with family and friends.


## Dr. Narjes Ahmadi, D.D.S.


Dr. Ahmadi began her dental career at the University of Maryland, where she earned her bachelor’s degree in Dental Hygiene before going on to complete her Doctor of Dental Surgery (DDS). With a gentle, caring approach, she is committed to making dentistry a pain-free and positive experience for every patient.

She believes that everyone deserves personalized, comprehensive care—and takes the time to ensure her patients feel comfortable, informed, and confident at every step of their dental journey.

Outside the office, Dr. Ahmadi enjoys traveling and cherishing time with her family, especially her two young boys.


## Dr. Katy Vu, D.D.S.


Dr. Katy is a compassionate and skilled dentist with a well-rounded background in all areas of dentistry. Since earning her DDS from the University at Buffalo in 2015, she’s developed a special connection with children and families, known for her gentle care and calming presence.

Originally from Syracuse, NY, Dr. Vu now lives in Orange County with her family and loves giving back—both in her daily work and through volunteer trips to Haiti and the Dominican Republic. Her patients appreciate not just her clinical skill, but how genuinely cared for and at ease she makes them feel.


## Dr. Nathan Francesco Nguyen, D.D.S.


Dr. Nguyen specializes in smile makeovers, veneers, full mouth reconstruction, and dental implants. Known for his skill, attention to detail, and compassionate approach, he is dedicated to helping patients feel confident in their smiles.

A Southern California native, Dr. Nguyen earned both his undergraduate and Doctor of Dental Surgery degrees from USC, and completed a postdoctoral master’s in Prosthodontics at the University of Siena in Italy.

He believes dentistry is a blend of science and artistry, using advanced techniques to create natural, beautiful results in a comfortable setting.

Outside the office, he enjoys exploring new restaurants, traveling, and spending time with family.


## Dr. Catherine Young, D.D.S.


Dr. Catherine Young earned her Doctor of Dental Medicine degree from Tufts University School of Dental Medicine in Boston and completed a General Practice Residency at Jamaica Hospital in New York. After several years in private practice in New York City, she relocated to Southern California, where she has been providing comprehensive general dentistry for over a decade.

Dr. Young is known for her gentle chairside manner and her commitment to making patients feel comfortable, informed, and confident in their care. She believes great dentistry begins with listening and building trust, and she takes pride in delivering thoughtful, personalized treatment for every patient. Dedicated to clinical excellence, Dr. Young stays current with the latest advancements in dentistry through continuing education and professional study clubs.

Outside the office, Dr. Young enjoys spending time with her family. You might find her at Disneyland chasing after her toddler, at the park keeping up with her corgi, or wandering Costco in search of her husband.


## Dr. Sarah Wang, D.D.S.


Dr. Wang is a compassionate and detail-oriented dentist dedicated to providing exceptional, patient-centered care. She earned her dental degree from the University of the Pacific Arthur A. Dugoni School of Dentistry in San Francisco, where she developed a strong foundation in comprehensive dentistry.

After graduation, Dr. Wang spent six years practicing in New Mexico, gaining valuable experience and caring for a diverse community of patients. Originally from Los Angeles, she is excited to now be practicing in Orange County and serving the Southern California community.

Dr. Wang takes pride in helping patients feel comfortable, understood, and confident in their care, always focusing on thoughtful, personalized treatment.

Outside the office, she enjoys traveling and spending time with her husband, their two-year-old daughter, and newborn son.


## Dr. Rosemary Tran, D.D.S.


Dr. Rosemary Tran brings 13 years of clinical experience to Oceanic Dental, along with a warm, thoughtful approach centered on making patients feel comfortable, heard, and confident in their care. She enjoys all aspects of general dentistry, with a special interest in restorative and cosmetic dentistry, and takes pride in helping patients achieve healthy, natural-looking smiles through personalized treatment and open communication.

Dr. Tran earned her bachelor’s degree in Biological Sciences from Louisiana State University and her dental degree from the LSU School of Dentistry in 2013. After many years in private practice along the Gulf Coast, she relocated to Southern California to be closer to family. Dedicated to continually advancing her skills, she is an active member of the American Academy of Cosmetic Dentistry.

Outside the office, Dr. Tran enjoys traveling, discovering new restaurants, and spending time with family and friends. She looks forward to building lasting relationships with patients while helping them feel at ease—and proud of their smiles.
