# Dr. Krystal Pham – Your Trusted Family and Cosmetic Dentist


With over 20 years of experience and commitment to excellence ("America's Best Dentists 2025" by the National Consumer Advisory Board), Dr. Pham is more than just your dentist—she’s your trusted partner on the journey to a healthier smile.

Book with Dr. Pham


### Expertise Rooted in Family Tradition and Academic Excellence


Dr. Pham’s approach to dentistry is inspired by her family’s healthcare legacy and her exceptional academic background. An honors graduate of UCSF and former Assistant Clinical Professor, she emphasizes patient education and embraces technological innovation. With advanced training in implant and cosmetic dentistry, Dr. Pham is a trusted choice for patients across Orange County.


### Comprehensive Dental Care Tailored to Your Needs


Dr. Pham offers a full range of dental services, from preventive care and pediatric dentistry to cosmetic enhancements. Whether you're aiming to maintain a healthy smile, enhance its appearance, or address specific dental concerns, she provides personalized solutions with exceptional care.


## Cosmetic Dentistry and Smile Makeovers


Transform your smile with tailored cosmetic solutions, including teeth whitening, veneers, and Invisalign. Dr. Pham’s artistic touch ensures that your smile reflects your personality while boosting your confidence.

Book an Appointment


## Implant Dentistry


Restore your smile with secure, natural-looking dental implants. Dr. Pham specializes in placing and restoring implants, offering patients durable solutions that look and feel just like real teeth.


## Family Dentistry for All Ages


From your child’s first dental visit to maintaining oral health as you age, Dr. Pham provides comprehensive family care. Her gentle approach and friendly demeanor make her a trusted choice for patients of all ages.


## Building Trust Through Compassionate Care and Expertise


Dr. Pham believes that every smile tells a story, and she’s here to make sure yours is a reflection of a thriving, healthy life. Her focus on patient education, comfort, and long-term health means that every treatment is designed with your best interests at heart. Whether you’re here for routine care or a full smile makeover, you can trust that you’re in experienced, caring hands.

# Privacy Policy


Effective Date: November 6, 2024

Krystal Pham DDS, Inc. DBA Oceanic Dental (“Oceanic Dental,” “we,” “us,” or “our”) is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains our practices for collecting, using, and sharing information, including Personal Information and Protected Health Information (“PHI”), as it relates to our services provided through our website and third-party booking platforms.

This Privacy Policy applies to all who access, use, or interact with our services, including those who submit information through online forms for inquiries, appointment scheduling, insurance verification, and general communications with Oceanic Dental.

Please read this Privacy Policy carefully. By accessing or using our services, you agree to the terms outlined herein. If you do not agree to this Privacy Policy, please refrain from using our services.


## 1. Information We Collect


We collect various types of personal and health information when you use our services, interact with our website, or communicate with us. This includes:

Personal Identifiers: Information that can directly identify you, including your name, date of birth, contact information such as email, phone number(s), postal address, and insurance details.

Protected Health Information (PHI): Medical and dental information required for treatment and healthcare operations, in compliance with HIPAA regulations.

Internet and Electronic Activity: Device information, IP addresses, browsing activity on our website, and preferences.


## 2. How We Use Your Information


We use your information for purposes necessary to provide, improve, and protect our services, including:

Providing and Enhancing Services: For scheduling, insurance verification, patient communication, updates, and treatment.

Communication: To inform you of appointments, treatments, updates, offers, new services, or respond to inquiries.

Analysis and Improvement: To understand site usage, customize user experiences, and improve our services.


## 3. Text messaging and mobile privacy


Oceanic Dental may send appointment and scheduling messages, replies to your questions, care coordination messages, office updates, and promotional messages if you enroll in the applicable program. You may opt in through an affirmative SMS consent option on a website or booking form, in writing, or through another clearly disclosed method. Consent to promotional texts is not a condition of purchase or dental treatment.

You may receive up to four messages per week. Actual frequency depends on your appointments, requests, and the program for which you enrolled. Message and data rates may apply under your mobile plan. Oceanic Dental does not charge a separate text messaging fee.

Reply STOP to an Oceanic Dental text to opt out. We may send one final confirmation. To receive texts again, you must provide new consent. Reply HELP for assistance, email [email protected], or call (714) 378-0085 for Fountain Valley or (714) 841-0203 for Huntington Beach. Wireless carriers are not liable for delayed or undelivered messages.

We do not sell, rent, or share mobile telephone numbers, SMS opt-in data, or messaging consent with third parties or affiliates for their own marketing or promotional purposes. This restriction applies to the mobile information described here regardless of other sharing described in this policy. Our messaging platform, wireless carriers, and service providers may process mobile information only as needed to send or support our messages or as required by law. Consent to receive Oceanic Dental texts is not transferred to another business.

Text messages are not fully secure. Please do not send detailed medical histories, clinical images or records, payment card data, or other sensitive information by SMS. Call us to arrange a secure way to send clinical information.


## 4. How We Protect Your Information


We implement security measures to protect your information from unauthorized access, disclosure, or loss. While we strive to safeguard your data, transmission over the internet involves inherent risks. You agree to assume these risks and understand that no system can be guaranteed fully secure.


## 5. HIPAA Notice of Privacy Practices


Oceanic Dental follows the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) to safeguard Protected Health Information (PHI). This notice describes how we use and disclose your PHI and your rights concerning it.


### Scope of Notice


This notice applies to all PHI we maintain. PHI includes identifiable information related to your medical and dental health, treatment, and payment details.


### Our Responsibilities


We are required by law to:

Maintain the confidentiality of PHI.

Provide notice of our privacy practices.

Notify individuals if their unsecured PHI is compromised.


### How We Use and Disclose Your PHI


Your PHI may be used or disclosed without authorization for the following purposes:

Treatment: Disclosing PHI to healthcare providers to facilitate care.

Payment: Using PHI for billing, claims processing, and insurance purposes.

Healthcare Operations: For activities such as quality assessment, training, service improvement, and customer feedback.

Business Associates: We may share PHI with trusted vendors under contracts requiring data protection.


### Your Rights Regarding PHI


You have rights concerning your PHI, including:

Right to Access: To review and obtain a copy of your PHI.

Right to Amend: To request correction of inaccurate or incomplete information.

Right to Accounting: To request a record of disclosures made outside of treatment, payment, and healthcare operations.

Right to Restrict Disclosures: You may request additional restrictions on PHI disclosures. We will accommodate reasonable requests as required by law.

For questions or to exercise your rights, please contact us:

Mail: Oceanic Dental, Attn: Privacy Officer, 17991 Euclid St, Fountain Valley, CA 92708

Phone: (714) 378-0085

# Restore Your Smile with All-on-X Implants


If you’re dealing with missing or severely damaged teeth, Dr. Tanaka’s All-on-X dental implant solution can help restore your smile and improve your quality of life. This advanced procedure replaces an entire arch of teeth with just 4 or 6 strategically placed implants, giving you a stable, long-lasting, and natural-looking smile.


### Why Choose All-on-X?



#### Permanent Solution


Say goodbye to dentures. All-on-X implants offer a permanent, secure replacement for missing teeth.


#### Quick Recovery


With Dr. Tanaka’s expertise, many patients enjoy faster recovery times and leave with a new smile the same day.


#### Fewer Implants, Full Results


The procedure uses fewer implants to support a full set of teeth, making it less invasive while still providing full-mouth restoration.


#### Natural Appearance


Your new teeth are custom-made to match the look and feel of natural teeth, giving you a beautiful, natural smile.


## Why Dr. Tanaka?


With extensive experience in full-mouth reconstruction and prosthodontics, Dr. Tanaka has mastered the All-on-X implant procedure. His meticulous approach and commitment to detail ensure that every patient receives personalized care tailored to their unique needs, resulting in durable, natural-looking smiles.


### Academic Excellence


Dr. Tanaka’s decades-long career includes teaching roles as Assistant Clinical Professor and Boston University dental schools and academic researcher at Texas A&M where he co-authored a research paper on dentures. With board certifications and recognition for his contributions to prosthodontics, you can trust that you’re in expert hands.


### Specialized Prosthodontic Care


Dr. Tanaka focuses on life-changing treatments such as all-on-x, implant-supported dentures, crowns, and full-mouth reconstruction. Whether you need to restore a single tooth or rebuild your entire smile, he tailors every treatment to fit your unique needs. His attention to detail ensures that your smile is not only beautiful but functional for years to come.


### Ready to reclaim your smile?


Book a consultation with Dr. Tanaka and explore your implant options for a lasting, beautiful smile!

## FAQs


Find answers to commonly asked questions about our premier cosmetic, implant, and restorative dental services in Huntington Beach.

What is included in a smile makeover in Huntington Beach?

A smile makeover at Oceanic Dental can include porcelain veneers, teeth whitening, crowns, bonding, and sometimes Invisalign. Each case is customized based on your goals, facial features, and bite health. We use digital smile design to preview your results before treatment starts.

How long does a full-mouth reconstruction take at your Huntington Beach office?

Full-mouth reconstruction timelines vary based on the complexity of your case. Most patients complete treatment in 3 to 12 months. The process may include crowns, implants, bridges, bite correction, or dentures—all coordinated in a personalized, step-by-step plan.

Are dental implants offered at your Huntington Beach location?

Yes, we offer dental implants for single-tooth replacement, implant-supported bridges, and full-arch restorations like All-on-X. Dr. Noh, our oral surgery specialist and Dr. Tanaka, our in-house prosthodontist, specialize in restoring function and aesthetics using the most advanced implant systems.

What is the difference between All-on-X and regular dentures?

All-on-X uses 4 to 6 dental implants to support a fixed, full-arch prosthesis. Unlike traditional dentures, it doesn’t move, doesn’t need adhesive, and feels more like natural teeth. It's an ideal solution for patients seeking long-term stability and comfort.

How do I know if I need full-mouth reconstruction instead of individual procedures?

You might be a candidate if you have multiple worn, broken, or missing teeth, or if you're experiencing jaw pain or bite collapse. Full-mouth reconstruction combines function and aesthetics to restore your entire smile. Our team performs a full evaluation to determine the best path forward.

What types of veneers offered in Huntington Beach?

At Oceanic Dental, we offer both porcelain veneers for durability and esthetics, and composite veneers for quicker, more affordable cosmetic corrections. Veneers can address gaps, discoloration, uneven shapes, and chipped teeth as part of a smile enhancement plan.

Will my dental insurance cover cosmetic procedures like veneers or whitening?

Cosmetic procedures are typically not covered by dental insurance. However, if the treatment improves function—like crowns, implants, or reconstructive work—it may be partially reimbursed. Our team will help you navigate coverage and financing options.

Is cosmetic dentistry painful?

Most cosmetic procedures, like veneers or whitening, are minimally invasive and not painful. For more complex treatments like crowns or implants, we use gentle techniques and offer sedation options to ensure your comfort every step of the way.

How long does a smile makeover take from start to finish?

It depends on what’s involved. Whitening can be done in a single visit, while veneers or crowns may take a few weeks. Full mouth reconstruction or implants take longer. We’ll map out the timeline with you so everything feels clear and manageable.

Why do Huntington Beach patients choose Oceanic Dental for smile makeovers?

Oceanic Dental is known for combining cutting-edge technology with an artistic approach to cosmetic and restorative dentistry. Patients love our warm, spa-like studio, compassionate team, and the personalized attention we give every smile makeover and full-mouth restoration.

jsonld.name: Oceanic Dental – Huntington Beach
jsonld.description: Oceanic Dental – Huntington Beach offers comprehensive dental services near Main Street, serving local residents with top-rated dentists and specialists. From cosmetic to restorative care, we provide personalized, high-quality treatments in a warm and welcoming environment. Recognized by the Orange County Record People’s Choice Awards, our patients trust us for comfort-focused care, in-house expertise, and advanced technology.

mainEntity.name: What is included in a smile makeover in Huntington Beach?

acceptedAnswer.text: A smile makeover at Oceanic Dental can include porcelain veneers, teeth whitening, crowns, bonding, and sometimes Invisalign. Each case is customized based on your goals, facial features, and bite health. We use digital smile design to preview your results before treatment starts.

mainEntity.name: How long does a full-mouth reconstruction take at your Huntington Beach office?

acceptedAnswer.text: Full-mouth reconstruction timelines vary based on the complexity of your case. Most patients complete treatment in 3 to 12 months. The process may include crowns, implants, bridges, bite correction, or dentures—all coordinated in a personalized, step-by-step plan.

mainEntity.name: Are dental implants offered at your Huntington Beach location?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, we offer dental implants for single-tooth replacement, implant-supported bridges, and full-arch restorations like All-on-X. Dr. Noh, our oral surgery specialist and Dr. Tanaka, our in-house prosthodontist, specialize in restoring function and aesthetics using the most advanced implant systems.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between All-on-X and regular dentures?

acceptedAnswer.text: All-on-X uses 4 to 6 dental implants to support a fixed, full-arch prosthesis. Unlike traditional dentures, it doesn’t move, doesn’t need adhesive, and feels more like natural teeth. It's an ideal solution for patients seeking long-term stability and comfort.

mainEntity.name: How do I know if I need full-mouth reconstruction instead of individual procedures?

acceptedAnswer.text: You might be a candidate if you have multiple worn, broken, or missing teeth, or if you're experiencing jaw pain or bite collapse. Full-mouth reconstruction combines function and aesthetics to restore your entire smile. Our team performs a full evaluation to determine the best path forward.

mainEntity.name: What types of veneers offered in Huntington Beach?

acceptedAnswer.text: At Oceanic Dental, we offer both porcelain veneers for durability and esthetics, and composite veneers for quicker, more affordable cosmetic corrections. Veneers can address gaps, discoloration, uneven shapes, and chipped teeth as part of a smile enhancement plan.

mainEntity.name: Will my dental insurance cover cosmetic procedures like veneers or whitening?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cosmetic procedures are typically not covered by dental insurance. However, if the treatment improves function—like crowns, implants, or reconstructive work—it may be partially reimbursed. Our team will help you navigate coverage and financing options.

mainEntity.name: Is cosmetic dentistry painful?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most cosmetic procedures, like veneers or whitening, are minimally invasive and not painful. For more complex treatments like crowns or implants, we use gentle techniques and offer sedation options to ensure your comfort every step of the way.

mainEntity.name: How long does a smile makeover take from start to finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on what’s involved. Whitening can be done in a single visit, while veneers or crowns may take a few weeks. Full mouth reconstruction or implants take longer. We’ll map out the timeline with you so everything feels clear and manageable.

mainEntity.name: Why do Huntington Beach patients choose Oceanic Dental for smile makeovers?

acceptedAnswer.text: Oceanic Dental is known for combining cutting-edge technology with an artistic approach to cosmetic and restorative dentistry. Patients love our warm, spa-like studio, compassionate team, and the personalized attention we give every smile makeover and full-mouth restoration.

# Botox for TMJ& Teeth Grinding


If you suffer from teeth grinding (bruxism), TMJ pain, or jaw tension, Botox may provide relief. At Oceanic Dental, we use Botox as part of a comprehensive TMJ treatment plan to help relax overactive jaw muscles, reduce pain, and prevent long-term dental damage.


### What is TMJ?


The temporomandibular joint (TMJ) is the hinge that connects your jawbone to your skull, allowing you to chew, speak, and yawn. When the joint or surrounding muscles become inflamed or dysfunctional, it leads to TMJ disorder (TMD), which can cause pain, stiffness, and restricted jaw movement.

Common Causes of TMJ Disorders

‍- Teeth grinding & clenching – Puts excessive strain on the jaw muscles.

- Jaw injuries – Trauma or impact can damage the joint.

- Arthritis – Can wear down the TMJ, leading to dysfunction.

- Stress – Triggers muscle tension and jaw clenching.


### Symptoms of TMJ Dysfunction



### Jaw & Facial Pain


Discomfort ranging from mild aches to severe pain affecting daily activities.


### Jaw Dysfunction


Clicking, popping, stiffness, or lockjaw, making chewing and speaking difficult.


### Head, Neck & Ear Pain


MJ tension can trigger headaches, neck pain, and earaches.


### Swelling & Tooth Sensitivity


Inflammation may cause facial swelling and pressure on teeth.

How It Works?


## How Botox Helps with TMJ & Teeth Grinding


Chronic clenching and grinding put excessive strain on the temporomandibular joint (TMJ), leading to pain, stiffness, headaches, and tooth damage. Botox relaxes these overworked muscles, easing discomfort and protecting your teeth from wear, fractures, and costly restorative treatments.

Botox treatment is minimally invasive, requires no downtime, and takes just a few minutes. Results typically last 3-4 months, sometimes up to 6 months, depending on the severity of the condition. At Oceanic Dental, we take a holistic approach to TMJ treatment, with Botox as part of a comprehensive care plan. Once pain, swelling, and discomfort are under control, we can more easily explore long-term solutions, such as bite realignment, oral appliances, or other corrective treatments, to address the root cause of your TMJ disorder.


##### Pain & Headache Relief


Relaxes jaw muscles to ease TMJ pain, tension, and headaches.


##### Protects Teeth


Reduces grinding and clenching, preventing tooth wear and fractures.


##### Improves Jaw Function


Relieves stiffness, clicking, and lockjaw for better movement.


##### Quick & Non-Invasive


Minimally invasive treatment with no downtime, allowing you to resume daily activities immediately.


### Aesthetic Benefits of Botox for TMJ


Excessive jaw muscle tension can create a wide or bulky lower face. By relaxing these muscles, Botox slims and contours the jawline, enhancing overall facial harmony. Since facial muscles are interconnected, treating TMJ tension can also reduce stress lines on the forehead and around the eyes, resulting in a refreshed, natural look.

Our expert team, certified by the American Academy of Facial Esthetics, carefully assesses your symptoms and provides safe, customized treatment tailored to your needs. Schedule a consultation today to discover how Botox can relieve TMJ pain, protect your teeth, and enhance your natural appearance.

Schedule a Consultation


## FAQs


Find answers to commonly asked questions about Botox for TMJ.

How does Botox relieve TMJ pain?

Botox blocks nerve signals in the jaw muscles, reducing excessive contraction and tension. This helps relieve jaw pain, headaches, and teeth grinding while allowing the jaw to function more comfortably.

How long does Botox last for TMJ treatment?

Results typically last 3-4 months, sometimes up to 6 months, depending on the severity of your symptoms. Regular treatments may be recommended for long-term relief.

Will Botox completely cure my TMJ disorder?

Botox provides temporary relief but does not address the root cause of TMJ issues. Once pain and tension are under control, we can explore long-term solutions such as bite realignment or oral appliances.

How much does TMJ Botox treatment cost?

The cost of TMJ Botox treatment ranges from $500 to $1,500, depending on the number of units needed and the severity of your condition. A consultation will determine the best treatment plan for you.

Can Botox change my facial appearance?

Yes, Botox relaxes overactive jaw muscles, which can slim a bulky jawline and restore facial balance. It can also reduce tension-related wrinkles for a more refreshed look.

# The Rise of Hydroxyapatite Toothpaste: A Natural Ally for Your Pearly Whites


By

Oceanic Dental

11 Mar 2025

5 min read

The recent decision by Utah to ban fluoride from public drinking water has reignited discussions about dental health strategies. Fluoride has long been added to public water supplies to help prevent tooth decay, a practice endorsed by numerous health organizations. However, with this shift in policy, individuals and communities are exploring alternative methods to maintain oral health.

For those concerned about fluoride exposure or seeking natural dental care options, hydroxyapatite toothpaste offers a viable solution. It works by integrating with the tooth surface to fill in microscopic gaps and scratches, thereby repairing and fortifying enamel. This not only enhances tooth strength but also reduces sensitivity, providing a comprehensive approach to oral health.​

As communities adapt to changes in public health policies, it's essential to explore and adopt effective alternatives to traditional practices. Hydroxyapatite toothpaste stands out as a scientifically supported option for maintaining dental health in the absence of water fluoridation.

What is Hydroxyapatite?

Hydroxyapatite (HA) is a mineral your teeth and bones already know well. In fact, about 97% of your tooth enamel is made of it. Originally used by NASA to help astronauts repair teeth in space, this powerful mineral quickly became a dental superstar on Earth. ​

Why Choose Hydroxyapatite Toothpaste?

Here’s the magic of hydroxyapatite:

Rebuilds Your Enamel: HA fills in tiny cracks in your teeth, strengthening them from within—think of it like smoothing out potholes on a road.

Stops Sensitivity: HA seals the tiny channels that cause tooth sensitivity, making hot coffee or cold ice cream enjoyable again.

Naturally Whitens: No harsh chemicals here! HA gently polishes away surface stains, keeping your smile naturally bright.

Hydroxyapatite vs. Fluoride: A Friendly Comparison

You might wonder how hydroxyapatite stacks up against traditional fluoride toothpaste. Here’s what you need to know:

Effectiveness: Numerous studies confirm hydroxyapatite toothpaste protects teeth from cavities just as well—or even better—than fluoride.

Safety: Unlike fluoride, hydroxyapatite is safe if swallowed, making it ideal for children who often swallow toothpaste.

Gentle and Natural: HA is perfect for those seeking a natural, gentle toothpaste that’s friendly to sensitive mouths.


### Who Benefits Most from Hydroxyapatite?


Simply put, everyone can benefit—but especially:

People with Sensitive Teeth: HA provides gentle relief and lasting comfort.

Children and Families: A worry-free toothpaste if swallowed.

Natural Health Enthusiasts: Perfect for anyone preferring products aligned with their body’s natural chemistry.


### How to Get the Best Results from Hydroxyapatite Toothpaste


To enjoy maximum benefits, follow these simple tips:

Don’t Rinse Immediately: After brushing, spit but don’t rinse immediately. This allows HA to keep working longer.

Brush Gently: Always use a soft-bristle toothbrush with gentle, circular motions.

Stay Consistent: Brush regularly twice daily to maximize HA’s strengthening effects.


### Common Myths About Hydroxyapatite


“It’s Too New to Trust”: Actually, HA toothpaste has been used safely for decades.

“Less Effective than Fluoride”: Studies show it works equally or better.

“Doesn’t Whiten Teeth”: HA gently removes stains over time for a naturally brighter smile.


### Choose Natural, Choose Hydroxyapatite


Caring for your teeth doesn’t have to be complicated. Hydroxyapatite toothpaste offers an easy, safe, and natural way to strengthen your teeth and brighten your smile. Ready to try hydroxyapatite toothpaste or have more questions? At Oceanic Dental, we’re always here to help—just a smile away!

## FAQs


Find answers to commonly asked questions about our premier cosmetic, implant, and restorative dental services in Fountain Valley.

What makes someone a good candidate for cosmetic dentistry?

A good candidate is someone with healthy teeth and gums who wants to improve their smile’s appearance—whether it’s correcting stains, chips, gaps, or misalignment. At Oceanic Dental in Fountain Valley, we always start with a personalized consultation to understand your goals and evaluate what treatments are right for you.

Is a smile makeover permanent?

Smile makeovers are designed to last a long time, especially when veneers, crowns, or implants are involved. However, good home care, regular dental checkups, and healthy habits all help maintain your results. We’ll go over realistic timelines for each procedure during your consultation at our Fountain Valley office.

What is the difference between a crown and a veneer?

A veneer covers just the front of the tooth and is mostly cosmetic. A crown covers the entire tooth and is used when there's more structural damage. Both can improve your smile, but they serve slightly different purposes—and we’ll guide you to the right choice.

How do I know if I need full mouth reconstruction?

If you're dealing with multiple issues like broken teeth, missing teeth, jaw pain, or difficulty chewing, full mouth reconstruction might be a solution. It’s a comprehensive approach to restoring both the look and function of your smile. It starts with a full assessment and a custom plan. Please contact our Fountain Valley office at 714-378-0085 to schedule a consultation.

How long do dental implants last?

With proper care, dental implants can last 20+ years or even a lifetime. They’re one of the most durable and natural-feeling options for replacing missing teeth. We also help monitor your implant health at routine visits.

Are All-on-X implants better than dentures?

All-on-X is more stable and secure than traditional dentures and doesn’t require adhesive. For many patients, they feel and function more like natural teeth. That said, everyone’s situation is different, so we’ll help compare both options with your needs in mind.

Will dental insurance cover cosmetic procedures?

Most cosmetic procedures like veneers or whitening aren’t covered. However, if a procedure also restores function—like a crown or implant—it may be partially reimbursed. Our team is happy to help review your benefits and offer flexible options.

Do dental implants hurt?

Most patients say the procedure is easier than expected. We use numbing and sedation to keep you comfortable, and post-procedure soreness is usually mild and manageable. We'll talk you through each step and what to expect during healing.

How long does a smile makeover take from start to finish?

It depends on what’s involved. Whitening can be done in a single visit, while veneers or crowns may take a few weeks. Full mouth reconstruction or implants take longer. We’ll map out the timeline with you so everything feels clear and manageable.

What if I have anxiety about going to the dentist?

You’re not alone—many of our patients feel the same way. We offer gentle care, explain everything ahead of time, and provide comfort options like sedation if needed. We want you to feel relaxed and in control, every step of the way.

# Cosmetic Dentistry Costs in 2025


Enhancing your smile through cosmetic dentistry can significantly boost your confidence and overall well-being. At Oceanic Dental, we understand that one of the primary concerns for our patients is the cost associated with these transformative procedures. Below, we've outlined various cosmetic dental treatments along with their average costs to help you make informed decisions about your dental care.​

By

Oceanic Dental

08 Apr 2025

5 min read


## Teeth Whitening Cost


A brighter smile is often just a whitening treatment away. Professional in-office teeth whitening typically costs between $500 and $800, depending on the specific treatment and location. Over-the-counter options are available at lower prices, but professional treatments offer more immediate and noticeable results.


## Cost of Dental Veneers


Veneers are thin, custom-made shells designed to cover the front surface of teeth, improving their appearance. The cost of veneers varies widely, generally ranging from $1,000 to $2,500 per tooth. Factors influencing the price include the material used and the complexity of the individual's case.


## Cost of Dental Implants


For those missing one or more teeth, dental implants provide a durable and natural-looking solution. The average cost for a single dental implant ranges from $3,000 to $5,000. This estimate includes the implant placement, abutment, and crown.


## Cost of Invisalign (Clear Aligners)


Invisalign offers a discreet way to straighten teeth using clear aligners. Treatment costs typically range from $3,000 to $8,000, depending on the complexity of the case and the duration of treatment. Many dental insurance plans provide partial coverage for orthodontic treatments like Invisalign.


## Cost of Dental Crowns


Crowns, or caps, restore the shape, size, and function of damaged teeth. The cost of a dental crown generally falls between $1,150 and $1,750 per tooth. The price can vary based on the material chosen (porcelain, metal, or porcelain-fused-to-metal) and the tooth's location.


## Cost of Dental Bonding


Dental bonding involves applying a tooth-colored resin to repair chips, cracks, or gaps. This cost-effective procedure typically costs between $300 and $400 per tooth. Bonding is an excellent option for minor cosmetic enhancements.​


## Cost of All-On-4 Dental Implants


For patients seeking a full-arch replacement, the All-On-4 dental implant technique offers a comprehensive solution. As of 2025, the cost starts at approximately $25,000 per arch. This price includes the surgical placement of four implants and a fixed prosthesis.​

At Oceanic Dental, we are committed to providing transparent pricing and personalized treatment plans to meet your unique needs. Our team is happy to help with insurance verification to give you a clear picture of your benefits and out-of-pocket costs. We also offer flexible financing options, including up to 6 months of zero-interest plans and approvals without a hard credit check—making it easier for you to get the care you want, comfortably. For a detailed consultation and to discuss the best options for enhancing your smile, please contact our office in Fountain Valley or Huntington Beach.

Note: The prices shared are general estimates meant to give you a helpful starting point. Actual costs can vary based on your unique needs, treatment details, and the materials involved. For the most accurate pricing and personalized recommendations, we’d be happy to schedule a consultation with you.

# Dental Implants in Fountain Valley


Missing teeth can affect more than just your smile—they impact how you eat, speak, and feel. At Oceanic Dental in Fountain Valley, we offer advanced dental implant solutions designed to restore your health and confidence with long-lasting, natural-looking results. Our in-house team of specialists ensures your entire treatment happens under one roof—comfortably, efficiently, and with precision.

Restore Your Smile and Regain Confidence


## Dental Implants at Oceanic Dental - Fountain Valley


Dental implants at Oceanic Dental are simpler and more comfortable than you might expect. Our expert prosthodontist and oral surgeon in Fountain Valley ensure a perfect fit by assessing your oral health, bone structure, and smile goals.

Using advanced tech like CBCT scans, we make the process smooth and precise. With high-quality materials and careful planning, your implants will look and function just like natural teeth—restoring your confidence in eating, speaking, and smiling. From start to finish, we’re here with personalized, modern care to help you love your smile again!


## Why Choose Us for Dental Implants in Fountain Valley


With our trusted team and advanced technology, you can expect care that’s tailored to your needs every step of the way. Here’s why we’re your top choice for dental implants:

In-House Experts: Work with Dr. Tanaka (Prosthodontist) and Dr. Noh (Oral Surgeon) under one roof for seamless care.

Proven Excellence: Trusted throughout Orange County for high-quality dental care (recognized in the OC Register’s People’s Choice Awards, ⭐ 4.9 rating from 1,900+ patients).

Advanced Technology: We use 3D digital imaging, CBCT scans, and AI-assisted diagnostics to plan every case precisely.

Comfort-Focused Care: Sedation options and a gentle approach help ensure a stress-free experience from start to finish.

Superior Materials: We use E-max veneers, which are thinner, stronger, and more durable than traditional veneers. They resist chips, fractures, and stains, ensuring your smile stays beautiful longer.

Expert Solutions for Dark Teeth: For very dark teeth, we use Zirconia covered in clear porcelain to effectively mask discoloration while maintaining a natural look.

Expertise: Our lead dentist, Dr. Pham is an expert in cosmetic dentistry. She is a member of the American Academy of Cosmetic Dentistry and taught at UCSF School of Dentistry which is widely regarded as a top dental school.


## Dental Implant Options


We offer a full range of implant solutions tailored to your needs:


### Single-Tooth Implants


Replace one missing tooth with a natural-looking and permanent solution.


### Implant Bridges


Secure multiple missing teeth without relying on neighboring teeth.


### All-on-4 or All-on-X Implants


Restore your entire upper or lower arch using 4 to 6 implants to support a full set of teeth—stable, beautiful, and long-lasting.


### Snap-On Implant Dentures


Removable dentures anchored with implants for added security and comfort.

The Implant Journey: What to Expect


## Our Comprehensive Process in Fountain Valley


Dental implants are placed into the jawbone where they fuse with bone over time. The procedure typically involves three phases: planning, implant placement and healing, and finally restoration with a custom crown or denture. We use digital imaging and 3D planning for precise placement and long-term success.


###### Consultation and Planning


Start with a free consultation where you'll meet our in-house specialists, take photos, and discuss your dental needs. We evaluate your teeth, review treatment options, and answer all your questions. Using X-rays and detailed planning, we ensure your implants will be perfectly integrated and secured to your jawbone.


###### Implant Placement


We surgically place the titanium implant into your jawbone, creating a stable foundation for your new tooth. After the implant is placed, we allow time for it to integrate with the bone, ensuring a secure fit.


###### Abutment and Crown Placement


Once the implant has healed, we attach the abutment and custom-made crown. This final step restores the natural look and function of your tooth, completing your smile transformation.


## All-on-X Dental Implants with Dr. Tanaka


Dr. Tanaka - Oceanic Dental's prosthodontist in Fountain Valley - specializes in All-on-X solutions, a revolutionary approach to full-mouth restoration. All-on-X uses just 4-6 strategically placed dental implants to support a full arch of fixed, natural-looking replacement teeth. This advanced technique offers a stable, long-lasting solution for patients who are missing most or all of their teeth.


#### Immediate Results


In many cases, you can leave the office with a fully restored smile the same day.


#### Natural Look and Feel


The closest experience to natural teeth in terms of appearance, feel, and function.


#### Long-Lasting Solution


Can last a lifetime, offering a durable and reliable tooth replacement option.


#### No More Removable Dentures


Provide a secure, non-removable alternative for full-arch tooth replacement.


## Flexible Financing Options



#### Affordable Financing


Choose a payment plan that fits your budget and schedule.


#### No Hard Credit Check


No traditional credit check required.


#### Convenient


Easy auto-pay setup. No late fee.


#### Lightening Fast


Know if you are qualified and start your needed treatment within minutes.

Apply Now


## FAQs


Find answers to commonly asked questions about dental implant.

How much do dental implants cost in Orange County?

The cost of dental implants can range from $3,000 to $6,000 per tooth, depending on the complexity of the procedure and any additional treatments, like bone grafting. Multi-tooth implants, such as implant-supported bridges or full arch replacements (like All-on-4), can cost significantly more.

Is All-on-X better than traditional dentures?

Yes—All-on-X offers a permanent, secure, and natural-feeling solution using 4–6 implants to support a full arch. No adhesives, no slipping.

Who is a good candidate for All-on-4 dental implants?

Patients missing most or all teeth who have sufficient bone or are eligible for bone grafts are ideal candidates. A consultation with our prosthodontist can confirm.

How long does the implant process take?

Single implants typically require 3–6 months including healing. All-on-X cases may offer same-day temporary teeth with full healing over several months.

What if I need extractions or bone grafting?

We provide all treatments in-house, including gentle extractions, bone grafts, and socket preservation—so you don’t need to be referred out.

What’s the success rate of dental implants?

With proper planning and care, dental implants have a 95–98% success rate and can last decades—or a lifetime.

Are dental implants painful?

Most patients say it's easier than expected. We use local anesthesia or sedation for your comfort, and healing is usually mild.

Can I get implants in one day?

Yes. We offer same-day implant placement in select cases including All-on-X, allowing you to walk out with new teeth the same day.

Will my insurance cover implants?

Dental implant coverage depends on your insurance plan. While many dental insurance plans don’t fully cover implants, they may cover portions like extractions or crowns. Medical insurance might help if the implant is necessary due to an injury. We can help check with your provider and verify your coverage.

Why choose Oceanic Dental for implants?

We’re trusted by thousands of patients, with advanced digital planning, an in-house team of specialists, and unmatched patient care from two premier locations: Huntington Beach and Fountain Valley in Orange County.

## FAQs


Find answers to commonly asked questions about All-on-X dental implants.

What is All-on-X dental implants?

A full arch solution using 4–6 implants to support a fixed bridge. It's a modern alternative to dentures.

How long does the All-on-X procedure take?

You can receive extractions, implants, and temporary teeth all in one day. Final teeth are placed in 3–6 months.

Who is a candidate for All-on-X?

Anyone missing most or all teeth, or frustrated with dentures. Bone grafting can be added if needed.

Is it painful?

With sedation and proper aftercare, most patients report minimal discomfort. Pain is manageable and temporary.

What’s the difference between All-on-X and dentures?

All-on-X is fixed and feels like real teeth. No adhesives, no movement, and better chewing power.

How much does All-on-X cost in Fountain Valley?

Full cases range from $19,000–$30,000 per arch. We offer transparent quotes and financing.

Will my dental insurance cover All-on-X?

Insurance may help cover extractions, scans, or parts of the procedure. We help verify your benefits.

Do I need bone grafting first?

Not always. The angled placement of implants in All-on-X often avoids the need for grafting.

How long will it last?

With good care, All-on-X can last 20+ years or a lifetime.

Why Oceanic Dental in Fountain Valley?

We’re trusted by thousands of patients, with advanced digital planning, an in-house team of specialists, and unmatched patient care in Fountain Valley.

# Cosmetic Dentistry in Fountain Valley


A beautiful smile can change everything. At Oceanic Dental in Fountain Valley, we blend advanced techniques with artistic design to help you look and feel your best. Whether you’re dealing with chipped, stained, or uneven teeth, our cosmetic dentistry team is here to enhance your smile with precision, care, and style.


## Our Most Popular Cosmetic Dental Services in Fountain Valley


We offer a range of cosmetic dentistry procedures, from porcelain veneers to teeth whitening, to enhance your smile and boost your confidence.


### Porcelain Veneers & Crowns


Porcelain veneers are thin shells that cover the front of a tooth, addressing cosmetic concerns in two visits. Crowns, made from porcelain or a combination of porcelain and metal, provide full coverage and support for damaged, discolored, or weakened teeth.


### Dental Bonding


Bonding refers to the application of a tooth-colored resin to correct imperfections or enhance the shape of teeth. This procedure is often a favorable choice for cosmetic dental enhancements.


### Teeth Whitening


We provide in-house teeth whitening services using Zoom and Opalescence Boost, as well as offering professional-strength whitening kits.


### Dental Implants


Losing teeth can greatly affect not only the appearance of your smile, but also your overall oral health. For a reliable solution, we strongly recommend dental implants. Our team has extensive expertise in the precise placement of dental implants.


### Teeth straightening with Invisalign


With Invisalign clear aligners, teeth can be effectively and discreetly straightened. The comfortable plastic aligner trays are removable for brushing, flossing, and special occasions.


### Gum & Enamel Re-contouring


Gum re-contouring can improve an uneven gum line or a "gummy" smile. Enamel recontouring shapes natural teeth for a better appearance by removing small amounts of enamel to alter length, shape, or surface contours.

## FAQs


Find answers to commonly asked questions about cosmetic dentistry in Fountain Valley.

What’s included in a smile makeover?

A smile makeover is a personalized combination of cosmetic treatments designed to enhance your overall appearance. Depending on your needs, it can include porcelain veneers, teeth whitening, gum contouring, bonding, Invisalign, or crowns. At Oceanic Dental in Fountain Valley, we use digital smile design to plan your treatment and preview your new smile before we begin.

Are porcelain veneers permanent?

Veneers are considered long-term but not technically permanent. They last 10–15 years or more with proper care and require removing a small layer of enamel, which means you’ll always need some type of covering. Porcelain veneers are extremely durable, stain-resistant, and can transform the shape, color, and alignment of your teeth in just two visits.

What’s the difference between bonding and veneers?

Bonding is a quicker, more affordable option using tooth-colored resin to correct small chips, gaps, or discoloration. Veneers are thin ceramic shells bonded to the front of teeth to deliver a more durable and dramatic transformation. Bonding may last 3–7 years, while veneers typically last over a decade.

Is cosmetic dentistry painful?

Most cosmetic procedures are non-invasive or minimally invasive. Treatments like whitening and bonding involve little to no discomfort, while veneers may require mild enamel removal. We offer numbing and sedation options if needed, and most patients report little to no pain during or after cosmetic treatment.

How long does teeth whitening last?

In-office whitening can produce results that last from 1 to 3 years. This depends on your diet, oral hygiene, and habits like coffee or wine consumption. We also offer take-home whitening trays to help you maintain your brightness long after your visit.

Can cosmetic dentistry fix crooked teeth?

Yes—cosmetic dentistry can correct mild to moderate misalignment. Veneers or bonding can visually straighten teeth for a faster result. For more complex cases, we may recommend Invisalign to gently shift your teeth into alignment before completing cosmetic enhancements.

Will insurance cover cosmetic dentistry?

Most cosmetic procedures—like whitening, veneers, and bonding—are not covered by dental insurance because they’re considered elective. However, some treatments like crowns may be partially covered if there’s a functional need. Our team helps you review your benefits and offers flexible financing options.

How much does a smile makeover cost in Fountain Valley?

Smile makeover pricing depends on how many teeth are being treated and which procedures are used. Costs can range from $3,000 to $25,000+. We’ll create a detailed, personalized estimate at your consultation, with transparent fees and no surprises.

How quickly can I get results?

Some treatments like in-office whitening are completed in one visit. Veneers typically take two appointments over two weeks. Full smile makeovers involving Invisalign or implants may take several months. We’ll outline a clear timeline and help you plan every step of your transformation.

At Oceanic Dental, we combine artistic skill with the latest dental technology to deliver personalized, natural-looking results. Our Fountain Valley studio is designed by KOHAN - one of the best architects in California - to feel calm and comfortable, and our team includes cosmetic experts who truly listen. You’ll receive customized care from people who are just as invested in your smile as you are.

# Invisalign in Fountain Valley – Clear Braces for a Confident Smile


Straightening your teeth doesn’t have to mean metal braces. At Oceanic Dental in Fountain Valley, we offer Invisalign—an advanced clear aligner system that gently moves your teeth into place with virtually invisible trays. Whether you’re an adult seeking a confident smile or a teen looking for a comfortable solution, Invisalign fits your lifestyle and your look.

Special Event


## Invisalign Day


Invisalign has once again chosen Oceanic Dental to host this special event, showcasing our trusted partnership. On May 17, 2025, we are thrilled to offer exclusive discounts to help elevate your smile. Take advantage of limited-time savings of up to $2,000—don’t miss this opportunity to transform your smile!

Reserve Your Spot Today

Invisalign Magic


## Invisalign Can Help With


Invisalign isn’t just about straighter teeth—it’s about improving your bite, function, and confidence. At Oceanic Dental in Fountain Valley, we use clear aligners to treat a wide range of concerns, including:

Crooked or crowded teeth: When teeth overlap or twist due to lack of space, Invisalign gently moves them into alignment for a more balanced smile.

Gaps between teeth: Spaces between teeth can affect both appearance and oral health. Invisalign closes these gaps for a more even bite and smile.

Mild bite issues (overbite, underbite, crossbite): Invisalign can correct certain bite problems by guiding your teeth and jaw into a healthier, more functional position.

Teeth shifting after braces: Invisalign is a great option if your teeth have started to move after previous orthodontic treatment, helping restore your straight smile without metal braces.

The Process - Let's Break It Down


## The Clear Path to Your Dream Smile



###### Step 1: Consultation and Digital Impressions


Start with a free consultation to meet our friendly orthodontists, discuss your smile goals, and take digital impressions. Using advanced 3D imaging, we create a custom treatment plan and show you a preview of your new smile.


###### Step 2: Custom Aligner Creation and Fitting


Your custom Invisalign aligners are made from your digital impressions. These clear, comfortable aligners gradually shift your teeth. You’ll wear each set for about two weeks. Our team ensures a perfect fit and provides easy care instructions.


###### Step 3: Regular Check-Ins


We’ll schedule regular check-ins to monitor your progress and make adjustments as needed. Most treatments take 12 months or more, but you’ll see improvements in just a few weeks. Our goal is to keep your treatment on track and achieve the best results.


### Why Choose Oceanic Dental for Invisalign


At Oceanic Dental, we’re committed to providing top-tier Invisalign® treatments in Fountain Valley with expertise, precision, and personalized care.

Thousands of successful cases treated by our experienced team.


#### Digital Scans, No Messy Impressions

#### Fewer Appointments, Faster Results

#### Personalized Treatment Monitoring


We track your progress digitally and adjust your plan to stay on target.


## FAQs


Find answers to commonly asked questions about Invisalign in Fountain Valley.

What is Invisalign and how does it work?

Invisalign is a clear aligner system that straightens teeth using a series of custom-made, transparent plastic trays. Each aligner is worn for 1–2 weeks, gradually moving your teeth into the desired position. Unlike braces, Invisalign is removable and nearly invisible, making it ideal for both adults and teens who want a discreet way to improve their smile.

Is Invisalign as effective as braces?

Yes—Invisalign can be just as effective as traditional braces for treating mild to moderate alignment issues such as crowding, spacing, and some bite problems. Success depends on proper wear (20–22 hours/day). At Oceanic Dental in Fountain Valley, we tailor Invisalign treatment plans to achieve the same results you'd expect from braces—without the brackets and wires.

How long does Invisalign treatment take?

Most Invisalign cases are completed in 6–12 months, although complex cases can take up to 18 months. The exact duration depends on the severity of your alignment issues and your consistency in wearing the aligners. We use digital scanning and progress tracking at our Fountain Valley office to keep you on schedule.

Does Invisalign hurt?

Invisalign is generally not painful, but you may experience mild pressure or soreness when switching to a new tray. This feeling typically lasts a day or two and is a sign that your teeth are moving. The aligners are smooth and comfortable—no sharp brackets or wires to cause irritation.

Can I eat and drink with Invisalign?

No, you should remove your aligners when eating or drinking anything other than water. This prevents staining and warping of the trays. The benefit is that there are no food restrictions—you can enjoy your favorite meals as long as you brush before putting the aligners back in.

How do I clean my Invisalign aligners?

Clean your aligners daily with lukewarm water and a soft toothbrush, or use Invisalign cleaning crystals. Avoid hot water, as it can distort the shape. Proper hygiene keeps your trays clear and odor-free throughout treatment.

Will people know I’m wearing Invisalign?

Invisalign aligners are designed to be discreet. They're made from clear, medical-grade plastic that fits closely to your teeth, making them barely noticeable in everyday conversation or photos.

Is Invisalign suitable for adults?

Yes—Invisalign is an excellent choice for adults who want to straighten their teeth without the look of braces. It's especially popular among working professionals and parents who want effective results without disrupting their lifestyle.

Does insurance cover Invisalign?

Many PPO dental plans offer partial orthodontic coverage for Invisalign. Our Oceanic Dental team will verify your benefits and provide a breakdown of costs. We also offer 0% interest financing to make treatment affordable, even without insurance.

Why choose Oceanic Dental in Fountain Valley for Invisalign?

As a Gold Invisalign Provider, Oceanic Dental has successfully treated hundreds of local patients using advanced 3D scanning, personalized planning, and clear progress tracking. Our in-house specialists and patient-first approach make us a trusted choice for Invisalign in Fountain Valley.

## FAQs


Find answers to commonly asked questions about cosmetic dentistry in Fountain Valley.

At what age should my child see the dentist?

The American Dental Association recommends children see a dentist by their first birthday or within 6 months of the first tooth appearing. At Oceanic Dental, we make these early visits gentle, fun, and educational.

How often should families visit the dentist?

Every family member should have a dental checkup and cleaning every six months. These visits help catch small problems early and prevent more serious issues.

Can you treat my whole family in one visit?

Yes! We offer family block appointments so parents and children can be seen on the same day—saving time and making scheduling easier.

Do kids need fluoride treatments?

Fluoride helps protect kids’ teeth against cavities. We offer safe, effective fluoride applications during regular checkups, especially for children at higher risk.

What should I do if my child is nervous about the dentist?

We specialize in helping kids feel calm. Our friendly team uses simple language, gentle techniques, and a fun office atmosphere to make each visit a positive experience.

Do you offer dental sealants for children?

Yes—dental sealants are thin coatings placed on the chewing surfaces of molars to prevent decay. They're quick, painless, and very effective for cavity-prone kids.

What if my child has a dental emergency?

We offer same-day emergency visits for issues like toothaches, injuries, or broken fillings. Just call our Fountain Valley office, and we’ll get your child seen as quickly as possible.

Are you experienced in senior dental care?

Yes. We help seniors with dry mouth, gum disease, tooth replacement (like dentures or implants), and adapting care plans to medical needs or medications.

What insurances do you accept for family dentistry?

We accept most PPO plans and help you understand your benefits. We also offer financing options for treatments not fully covered by insurance.

We treat your family like our own—with warmth, patience, and a full range of dental services in one modern, comfortable location.

# Dental Implants in HUNTINGTON BEACH


Missing teeth can affect more than just your smile—they impact how you eat, speak, and feel. At Oceanic Dental in Huntington Beach, we offer advanced dental implant solutions designed to restore your health and confidence with long-lasting, natural-looking results. Our in-house team of specialists ensures your entire treatment happens under one roof—comfortably, efficiently, and with precision.

Restore Your Smile and Regain Confidence


## Dental Implants at Oceanic Dental - Huntington Beach


Dental implants at Oceanic Dental are simpler and more comfortable than you might expect. Our expert prosthodontist and oral surgeon in Huntington Beach ensure a perfect fit by assessing your oral health, bone structure, and smile goals.

Using advanced tech like CBCT scans, we make the process smooth and precise. With high-quality materials and careful planning, your implants will look and function just like natural teeth—restoring your confidence in eating, speaking, and smiling. From start to finish, we’re here with personalized, modern care to help you love your smile again!


## Why Choose Us for Dental Implants in Huntington Beach


With our trusted team and advanced technology, you can expect care that’s tailored to your needs every step of the way. Here’s why we’re your top choice for dental implants:

In-House Experts: Work with Dr. Tanaka (Prosthodontist) and Dr. Noh (Oral Surgeon) under one roof for seamless care.

Proven Excellence: Trusted throughout Orange County for high-quality dental care (recognized in the OC Register’s People’s Choice Awards, ⭐ 4.9 rating from 1,900+ patients).

Advanced Technology: We use 3D digital imaging, CBCT scans, and AI-assisted diagnostics to plan every case precisely.

Comfort-Focused Care: Sedation options and a gentle approach help ensure a stress-free experience from start to finish.

Superior Materials: We use E-max veneers, which are thinner, stronger, and more durable than traditional veneers. They resist chips, fractures, and stains, ensuring your smile stays beautiful longer.

Expert Solutions for Dark Teeth: For very dark teeth, we use Zirconia covered in clear porcelain to effectively mask discoloration while maintaining a natural look.

Expertise: Our lead dentist, Dr. Pham is an expert in cosmetic dentistry. She is a member of the American Academy of Cosmetic Dentistry and taught at UCSF School of Dentistry which is widely regarded as a top dental school.


## Dental Implant Options


We offer a full range of implant solutions tailored to your needs:


### Single-Tooth Implants


Replace one missing tooth with a natural-looking and permanent solution.


### Implant Bridges


Secure multiple missing teeth without relying on neighboring teeth.


### All-on-4 or All-on-X Implants


Restore your entire upper or lower arch using 4 to 6 implants to support a full set of teeth—stable, beautiful, and long-lasting.


### Snap-On Implant Dentures


Removable dentures anchored with implants for added security and comfort.

The Implant Journey: What to Expect


## Comprehensive Process in Our Huntington Beach Clinic


Dental implants are placed into the jawbone where they fuse with bone over time. The procedure typically involves three phases: planning, implant placement and healing, and finally restoration with a custom crown or denture. We use digital imaging and 3D planning for precise placement and long-term success.


###### Consultation and Planning


Start with a free consultation where you'll meet our in-house specialists, take photos, and discuss your dental needs. We evaluate your teeth, review treatment options, and answer all your questions. Using X-rays and detailed planning, we ensure your implants will be perfectly integrated and secured to your jawbone.


###### Implant Placement


We surgically place the titanium implant into your jawbone, creating a stable foundation for your new tooth. After the implant is placed, we allow time for it to integrate with the bone, ensuring a secure fit.


###### Abutment and Crown Placement


Once the implant has healed, we attach the abutment and custom-made crown. This final step restores the natural look and function of your tooth, completing your smile transformation.


## All-on-X Dental Implants with Dr. Tanaka


Dr. Tanaka - Oceanic Dental's prosthodontist in Fountain Valley - specializes in All-on-X solutions, a revolutionary approach to full-mouth restoration. All-on-X uses just 4-6 strategically placed dental implants to support a full arch of fixed, natural-looking replacement teeth. This advanced technique offers a stable, long-lasting solution for patients who are missing most or all of their teeth.


#### Immediate Results


In many cases, you can leave the office with a fully restored smile the same day.


#### Natural Look and Feel


The closest experience to natural teeth in terms of appearance, feel, and function.


#### Long-Lasting Solution


Can last a lifetime, offering a durable and reliable tooth replacement option.


#### No More Removable Dentures


Provide a secure, non-removable alternative for full-arch tooth replacement.


## Flexible Financing Options for Huntington Beach Patients



#### Affordable Financing


Choose a payment plan that fits your budget and schedule.


#### No Hard Credit Check


No traditional credit check required.


#### Convenient


Easy auto-pay setup. No late fee.


#### Lightening Fast


Know if you are qualified and start your needed treatment within minutes.

Apply Now


## FAQs


Find answers to commonly asked questions about dental implant.

How much do dental implants cost in Orange County?

The cost of dental implants can range from $3,000 to $6,000 per tooth, depending on the complexity of the procedure and any additional treatments, like bone grafting. Multi-tooth implants, such as implant-supported bridges or full arch replacements (like All-on-4), can cost significantly more.

Is All-on-X better than traditional dentures?

Yes—All-on-X offers a permanent, secure, and natural-feeling solution using 4–6 implants to support a full arch. No adhesives, no slipping.

Who is a good candidate for All-on-4 dental implants?

Patients missing most or all teeth who have sufficient bone or are eligible for bone grafts are ideal candidates. A consultation with our prosthodontist can confirm.

How long does the implant process take?

Single implants typically require 3–6 months including healing. All-on-X cases may offer same-day temporary teeth with full healing over several months.

What if I need extractions or bone grafting?

We provide all treatments in-house, including gentle extractions, bone grafts, and socket preservation—so you don’t need to be referred out.

What’s the success rate of dental implants?

With proper planning and care, dental implants have a 95–98% success rate and can last decades—or a lifetime.

Are dental implants painful?

Most patients say it's easier than expected. We use local anesthesia or sedation for your comfort, and healing is usually mild.

Can I get implants in one day?

Yes. We offer same-day implant placement in select cases including All-on-X, allowing you to walk out with new teeth the same day.

Will my insurance cover implants?

Dental implant coverage depends on your insurance plan. While many dental insurance plans don’t fully cover implants, they may cover portions like extractions or crowns. Medical insurance might help if the implant is necessary due to an injury. We can help check with your provider and verify your coverage.

Why choose Oceanic Dental for implants?

We’re trusted by thousands of patients, with advanced digital planning, an in-house team of specialists, and unmatched patient care from two premier locations: Huntington Beach and Fountain Valley in Orange County.

# Cosmetic Dentistry in Huntington Beach


A beautiful smile can change everything. At Oceanic Dental in Huntington Beach, we blend advanced techniques with artistic design to help you look and feel your best. Whether you’re dealing with chipped, stained, or uneven teeth, our cosmetic dentistry team is here to enhance your smile with precision, care, and style.


## Our Most Popular Cosmetic Dental Services in Huntington Beach


We offer a range of cosmetic dentistry procedures, from porcelain veneers to teeth whitening, to enhance your smile and boost your confidence.


### Porcelain Veneers & Crowns


Porcelain veneers are thin shells that cover the front of a tooth, addressing cosmetic concerns in two visits. Crowns, made from porcelain or a combination of porcelain and metal, provide full coverage and support for damaged, discolored, or weakened teeth.


### Dental Bonding


Bonding refers to the application of a tooth-colored resin to correct imperfections or enhance the shape of teeth. This procedure is often a favorable choice for cosmetic dental enhancements.


### Teeth Whitening


We provide in-house teeth whitening services using Zoom and Opalescence Boost, as well as offering professional-strength whitening kits.


### Dental Implants

## FAQs


Find answers to commonly asked questions about cosmetic dentistry in Huntington Beach.

What’s included in a smile makeover?

A smile makeover is a personalized combination of cosmetic treatments designed to enhance your overall appearance. Depending on your needs, it can include porcelain veneers, teeth whitening, gum contouring, bonding, Invisalign, or crowns. At Oceanic Dental in Huntington Beach, we use digital smile design to plan your treatment and preview your new smile before we begin.

Are porcelain veneers permanent?

Veneers are considered long-term but not technically permanent. They last 10–15 years or more with proper care and require removing a small layer of enamel, which means you’ll always need some type of covering. Porcelain veneers are extremely durable, stain-resistant, and can transform the shape, color, and alignment of your teeth in just two visits.

What’s the difference between bonding and veneers?

Bonding is a quicker, more affordable option using tooth-colored resin to correct small chips, gaps, or discoloration. Veneers are thin ceramic shells bonded to the front of teeth to deliver a more durable and dramatic transformation. Bonding may last 3–7 years, while veneers typically last over a decade.

Is cosmetic dentistry painful?

Most cosmetic procedures are non-invasive or minimally invasive. Treatments like whitening and bonding involve little to no discomfort, while veneers may require mild enamel removal. We offer numbing and sedation options if needed, and most patients report little to no pain during or after cosmetic treatment.

How long does teeth whitening last?

In-office whitening can produce results that last from 1 to 3 years. This depends on your diet, oral hygiene, and habits like coffee or wine consumption. We also offer take-home whitening trays to help you maintain your brightness long after your visit.

Can cosmetic dentistry fix crooked teeth?

Yes—cosmetic dentistry can correct mild to moderate misalignment. Veneers or bonding can visually straighten teeth for a faster result. For more complex cases, we may recommend Invisalign to gently shift your teeth into alignment before completing cosmetic enhancements.

Will insurance cover cosmetic dentistry?

Most cosmetic procedures—like whitening, veneers, and bonding—are not covered by dental insurance because they’re considered elective. However, some treatments like crowns may be partially covered if there’s a functional need. Our team helps you review your benefits and offers flexible financing options.

How much does a smile makeover cost in Huntington Beach?

Smile makeover pricing depends on how many teeth are being treated and which procedures are used. Costs can range from $3,000 to $25,000+. We’ll create a detailed, personalized estimate at your consultation, with transparent fees and no surprises.

How quickly can I get results?

Some treatments like in-office whitening are completed in one visit. Veneers typically take two appointments over two weeks. Full smile makeovers involving Invisalign or implants may take several months. We’ll outline a clear timeline and help you plan every step of your transformation.

Why choose Oceanic Dental - Huntington Beach for cosmetic dentistry?

At Oceanic Dental, we combine artistic skill with the latest dental technology to deliver personalized, natural-looking results. Our Huntington Beach studio by the lake offers a peaceful setting and advanced tools, and our cosmetic dentists are known for their gentle care and exceptional outcomes.

## FAQs

At what age should my child see the dentist?

The American Dental Association recommends children see a dentist by their first birthday or within 6 months of the first tooth appearing. At Oceanic Dental, we make these early visits gentle, fun, and educational.

How often should families visit the dentist?

Every family member should have a dental checkup and cleaning every six months. These visits help catch small problems early and prevent more serious issues.

Can you treat my whole family in one visit?

Yes! We offer family block appointments so parents and children can be seen on the same day—saving time and making scheduling easier.

Do kids need fluoride treatments?

Fluoride helps protect kids’ teeth against cavities. We offer safe, effective fluoride applications during regular checkups, especially for children at higher risk.

What should I do if my child is nervous about the dentist?

We specialize in helping kids feel calm. Our friendly team uses simple language, gentle techniques, and a fun office atmosphere to make each visit a positive experience.

Do you offer dental sealants for children?

Yes—dental sealants are thin coatings placed on the chewing surfaces of molars to prevent decay. They're quick, painless, and very effective for cavity-prone kids.

What if my child has a dental emergency?

We offer same-day emergency visits for issues like toothaches, injuries, or broken fillings. Just call our Fountain Valley office, and we’ll get your child seen as quickly as possible.

Are you experienced in senior dental care?

Yes. We help seniors with dry mouth, gum disease, tooth replacement (like dentures or implants), and adapting care plans to medical needs or medications.

What insurances do you accept for family dentistry?

We accept most PPO plans and help you understand your benefits. We also offer financing options for treatments not fully covered by insurance.

## FAQs


Find answers to commonly asked questions about our cosmetic, implant, and restorative dental services.

What makes someone a good candidate for cosmetic dentistry?

A good candidate is someone with healthy teeth and gums who wants to improve their smile’s appearance—whether it’s correcting stains, chips, gaps, or misalignment. At Oceanic Dental, we always start with a personalized consultation to understand your goals and evaluate what treatments are right for you.

Is a smile makeover permanent?

Smile makeovers are designed to last a long time, especially when veneers, crowns, or implants are involved. However, good home care, regular dental checkups, and healthy habits all help maintain your results. We’ll go over realistic timelines for each procedure during your consultation.

What is the difference between a crown and a veneer?

A veneer covers just the front of the tooth and is mostly cosmetic. A crown covers the entire tooth and is used when there's more structural damage. Both can improve your smile, but they serve slightly different purposes—and we’ll guide you to the right choice.

How do I know if I need full mouth reconstruction?

If you're dealing with multiple issues like broken teeth, missing teeth, jaw pain, or difficulty chewing, full mouth reconstruction might be a solution. It’s a comprehensive approach to restoring both the look and function of your smile. It starts with a full assessment and a custom plan. Please contact our nearest office at 714-378-0085 to schedule a consultation.

How long do dental implants last?

With proper care, dental implants can last 20+ years or even a lifetime. They’re one of the most durable and natural-feeling options for replacing missing teeth. We also help monitor your implant health at routine visits.

Are All-on-X implants better than dentures?

All-on-X is more stable and secure than traditional dentures and doesn’t require adhesive. For many patients, they feel and function more like natural teeth. That said, everyone’s situation is different, so we’ll help compare both options with your needs in mind.

Will dental insurance cover cosmetic procedures?

Most cosmetic procedures like veneers or whitening aren’t covered. However, if a procedure also restores function—like a crown or implant—it may be partially reimbursed. Our team is happy to help review your benefits and offer flexible options.

Do dental implants hurt?

Most patients say the procedure is easier than expected. We use numbing and sedation to keep you comfortable, and post-procedure soreness is usually mild and manageable. We'll talk you through each step and what to expect during healing.

How long does a smile makeover take from start to finish?

It depends on what’s involved. Whitening can be done in a single visit, while veneers or crowns may take a few weeks. Full mouth reconstruction or implants take longer. We’ll map out the timeline with you so everything feels clear and manageable.

What if I have anxiety about going to the dentist?

You’re not alone—many of our patients feel the same way. We offer gentle care, explain everything ahead of time, and provide comfort options like sedation if needed. We want you to feel relaxed and in control, every step of the way.

# Porcelain Dental Crowns in Huntington Beach


At Oceanic Dental in Huntington Beach, we craft high-quality porcelain crowns that restore both the strength and beauty of your teeth. Whether you’ve experienced decay, a cracked tooth, or had a root canal, our team provides long-lasting, custom crowns using the latest digital scanning and ceramic technology.

What are Dental Crowns?


## What are Porcelain Crowns?


Porcelain crowns are tooth-shaped caps that are placed over damaged or decayed teeth to restore their shape, size, strength, and appearance. They are made from high-quality porcelain, which mimics the natural translucency of teeth, making them an ideal choice for a natural-looking restoration. Whether you need to protect a weakened tooth, cover a discolored tooth, or support a tooth with a large filling, porcelain crowns provide a versatile and effective solution.


## When Is a Crown Needed?


Dental crowns are needed when a tooth is weakened, damaged, or aesthetically compromised.

Strengthening Teeth: To cover and protect teeth that have been severely weakened by large cavities or extensive decay.

Post-Root Canal and Implants: To protect teeth after root canals and to attach to dental implants for replacing missing teeth.

Aesthetic and Functional Improvements: Enhance the color, shape, and alignment of teeth, and correct bite issues.

Restore Your Smile with Ease


## Getting Porcelain Crowns in Huntington Beach Today is a Straightforward and Stress-Free Experience


At Oceanic Dental, getting a porcelain crown is a simple and stress-free experience. Our Huntington Beach dental experts ensure that every step is tailored to your specific needs, providing you with a high-quality crown that's durable and natural-looking, restoring your smile to its best.


### Free Consultation & Personalized Planning


Start with a complimentary consultation where you'll meet our friendly doctors, have photos taken, and discuss your dental goals. We’ll evaluate your teeth, explore treatment options, and answer all your questions. With detailed X-rays, 3D oral scans, and precise planning, we ensure your crown will be a perfect fit.


### Preparation and Custom Crafting


We carefully prepare your tooth by removing any decay and shaping it for the crown. An impression is then taken to create your custom crown. You'll receive a temporary crown while the permanent one is crafted.


### Placement and Final Adjustments


Once your permanent crown is ready, we will schedule an appointment for its placement. Our dentists will ensure a precise fit, making any necessary adjustments to ensure your comfort and bite alignment. This process ensures you receive a high-quality porcelain crown with minimal hassle, restoring your smile to its best.


## Why Huntington Beach Patients Choose Us



### Not All Crowns Are Created Equal


At Oceanic Dental, we uphold a high standard for dental crowns. We believe a dental crown should do more than restore a tooth—it should blend seamlessly into your smile, feel completely natural, and stand the test of time. That’s why our doctors and experienced technicians approach every crown with meticulous care and craftsmanship.

Each crown is custom-designed to match the exact shade, shape, and translucency of your natural teeth, ensuring a flawless, lifelike result.

With ultra-precise margins and high-quality materials, we create crowns that not only look beautiful but also function effortlessly.

Every detail, from the way light reflects off the surface to the perfect fit against your gumline, is carefully considered.

We are confident that at Oceanic Dental, we don’t just make crowns—we create seamless extensions of your natural teeth, restoring confidence and comfort with every smile.


## FAQs


Find answers to commonly asked questions by Huntington Beach patients about dental crowns.

How long do porcelain crowns last?

Porcelain crowns typically last between 10 to 15 years with proper care. Good oral hygiene, regular checkups, and avoiding habits like teeth grinding can help extend their lifespan.

Do porcelain crowns look natural?

Yes. Porcelain crowns are designed to match the color, shape, and translucency of natural teeth. They blend in seamlessly and are often indistinguishable from your real teeth.

When do I need a crown instead of a filling?

A crown is typically recommended when a tooth is too damaged or weakened to support a filling. This includes cases with large cavities, cracks, after a root canal, or for cosmetic reshaping.

Is getting a crown painful?

The procedure is usually not painful. We use local anesthesia to keep you comfortable. You may experience slight sensitivity or soreness afterward, which typically resolves quickly.

How many visits does a porcelain crown take?

Most porcelain crowns require two visits: one to prepare the tooth and take a digital scan, and another to fit and place the final crown. In some cases, a temporary crown is used in between.
